option_A: Reassign all of her stories to another developer for now
option_B: Postpone the standup until the issue is fixed
option_C: Discuss the database setup in detail right away
option_D: Note the impediment and resolve it after the standup
explanation_en: Note the impediment in the standup and resolve it after the meeting with the people involved.
explanation_vi: Ghi nhận trở ngại (impediment) trong standup, giải quyết sau buổi họp với những người liên quan.
in_short_en: Raise blockers at the standup and resolve them right after it.
in_short_vi: Nêu trở ngại trong standup và giải quyết ngay sau buổi họp.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In a Kanban system, how does a team member get new work?
option_A: Pulls the next item when capacity frees up
option_B: Takes any item as soon as it is added
option_C: Starts several items to stay fully busy
option_D: Waits for the manager to assign the next item
explanation_en: Pull system: team members pull the next item when they have spare capacity.
explanation_vi: Hệ thống kéo (pull system): thành viên kéo việc tiếp theo khi có năng lực trống.
in_short_en: Kanban is a pull system: pull the next item when capacity is available.
in_short_vi: Kanban là hệ thống kéo: kéo việc tiếp theo khi có năng lực trống.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A Kanban board shows: To Do (12), In Progress (9, WIP limit 5), Done (20). What should the team do FIRST?
option_A: Pull more items so that everyone stays busy
option_B: Move the unfinished items back to the To Do column
option_C: Stop starting work and finish what is in progress
option_D: Raise the In Progress limit to match current work
explanation_en: The In Progress column exceeds its WIP limit; the team should stop starting new work and focus on finishing work in progress.
explanation_vi: Cột In Progress vượt giới hạn WIP; đội nên ngừng bắt đầu việc mới và tập trung hoàn thành việc dở dang.
in_short_en: When WIP exceeds the limit, stop starting and start finishing.
in_short_vi: Khi WIP vượt giới hạn, ngừng bắt đầu việc mới và tập trung hoàn thành việc dở dang.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Early in a project, a team needs a quick, rough size for 80 epics. Which estimation technique is MOST efficient?
option_A: Parametric estimating
option_B: Three-point estimating
option_C: T-shirt sizing
option_D: Bottom-up estimating
explanation_en: T-shirt sizing (S, M, L, XL) gives quick, relative results and suits rough estimates for many items.
explanation_vi: Ước lượng theo cỡ áo (T-shirt sizing: S, M, L, XL) cho kết quả nhanh, tương đối, phù hợp khi cần ước lượng thô số lượng lớn.
in_short_en: T-shirt sizing gives quick relative estimates for many items early on.
in_short_vi: Ước lượng theo cỡ áo cho kết quả tương đối nhanh với nhiều hạng mục ở giai đoạn đầu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A product owner ranks backlog items by dividing each item's estimated value by its size, so that high-value, low-effort items come first. What does this ordering mainly support?
option_A: Removing the need to estimate story sizes
option_B: Delivering the most value as early as possible
option_C: Reducing the total number of user stories
option_D: Raising the velocity the team can achieve each sprint
explanation_en: Ordering by value divided by effort delivers the most value soonest (similar to WSJF in SAFe).
explanation_vi: Xếp theo giá trị chia cho công sức giúp giao nhiều giá trị nhất sớm nhất (tương tự WSJF trong SAFe).
in_short_en: Ordering by value relative to size delivers the most value earliest.
in_short_vi: Sắp xếp theo giá trị so với kích thước giúp giao nhiều giá trị nhất sớm nhất.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: After stories are selected in sprint planning, how do the developers usually manage the detailed work?
option_A: They break the stories into tasks and self-assign them
option_B: The Scrum master assigns each task to a developer
option_C: The product owner estimates each task in hours
option_D: The project manager builds a detailed task-level Gantt chart
explanation_en: Developers break stories into tasks and self-assign them, showing self-organization.
explanation_vi: Developers chia story thành task và tự nhận việc (self-assign), thể hiện tính tự tổ chức.
in_short_en: Developers break stories into tasks and self-assign them.
in_short_vi: Developers chia story thành task và tự nhận việc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Near the end of a sprint, one high-priority story is at risk. Several developers pause their own tasks to help finish it together. What is this practice called?
option_A: Crashing
option_B: Swarming
option_C: Fast tracking
option_D: Multitasking
explanation_en: Swarming: several team members focus together on finishing one priority item.
explanation_vi: Swarming: nhiều thành viên cùng tập trung hoàn thành một hạng mục ưu tiên.
in_short_en: Several team members converging on one item to finish it is swarming.
in_short_vi: Nhiều thành viên cùng dồn sức hoàn thành một hạng mục là swarming.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In a claims-handling improvement initiative, one person is accountable for how the claims process is designed and how well it performs end to end. Another person runs the process day to day. What are their roles, respectively?
option_A: Product owner; product manager
option_B: Process manager; process owner
option_C: Process owner; process manager
option_D: Project sponsor; project manager
explanation_en: The process owner is accountable for the design and effectiveness of the process; the process manager runs it day to day.
explanation_vi: Chủ quy trình (process owner) chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế và hiệu quả quy trình; người quản lý quy trình (process manager) vận hành hằng ngày.
in_short_en: The process owner is accountable for the process; the process manager runs it daily.
in_short_vi: Process owner chịu trách nhiệm về quy trình; process manager vận hành nó hằng ngày.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst joins a project late and needs each stakeholder's role, contact details, expectations, and level of influence. Which artifact should the BA review FIRST?
option_A: RACI chart
option_B: Communications management plan
option_C: Stakeholder register
option_D: Project charter
explanation_en: The stakeholder register contains identification, assessment, and classification information about stakeholders.
explanation_vi: Sổ đăng ký stakeholder (stakeholder register) chứa thông tin nhận diện, đánh giá và phân loại stakeholder.
in_short_en: Stakeholder roles, expectations, and influence are recorded in the stakeholder register.
in_short_vi: Vai trò, kỳ vọng và mức ảnh hưởng của stakeholder được ghi trong stakeholder register.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: How does a product manager's role typically differ from a product owner's role?
option_A: The product manager writes the code; the product owner tests it
option_B: They are identical roles that simply have different titles
option_C: Product manager: strategy and vision; product owner: the team's backlog
option_D: The product owner sets product prices; the product manager runs the Daily Scrum
explanation_en: The product manager looks after the product's strategy, market, and long-term vision; the product owner maximizes the value the team delivers by managing and ordering the backlog.
explanation_vi: Product manager lo chiến lược, thị trường và tầm nhìn dài hạn của sản phẩm; product owner tối đa hóa giá trị team bàn giao bằng cách quản lý và sắp xếp backlog.
in_short_en: Product managers own strategy and vision; product owners own the team's backlog.
in_short_vi: Product manager sở hữu chiến lược và tầm nhìn; product owner sở hữu backlog của đội.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A regulator has high power but rarely engages, and their approval is required for launch. Which engagement strategy is BEST?
option_A: Monitor them with minimum effort until launch
option_B: Keep them informed with a weekly newsletter only
option_C: Manage them closely with daily updates and workshops
option_D: Keep satisfied and involve them at key decisions
explanation_en: Keep satisfied: proactively meet their compliance requirements and involve them at key decision points.
explanation_vi: Keep satisfied: chủ động (proactive) đáp ứng các yêu cầu tuân thủ (compliance) và mời họ tham gia ở các điểm quyết định then chốt.
in_short_en: High power, low interest stakeholders are kept satisfied and involved at key points.
in_short_vi: Stakeholder quyền lực cao, ít quan tâm được giữ hài lòng và mời tham gia ở các điểm then chốt.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A predictive project will replace a retailer's loyalty program. The sponsor asks who will run requirements workshops with store managers and keep every requirement traceable to the business objectives. The project manager already handles schedule, budget, and team. Which role should take on this work?
option_A: Quality assurance lead
option_B: Project coordinator
option_C: Product owner
option_D: Business analyst
explanation_en: The business analyst (BA) is responsible for eliciting requirements, analyzing them, and maintaining traceability to business objectives.
explanation_vi: Chuyên viên phân tích nghiệp vụ (business analyst - BA) chịu trách nhiệm khơi gợi yêu cầu (elicitation), phân tích và giữ khả năng truy vết (traceability) về mục tiêu kinh doanh.
in_short_en: Eliciting requirements and tracing them to business objectives is core business analyst work.
in_short_vi: Khơi gợi yêu cầu và truy vết chúng về mục tiêu kinh doanh là công việc cốt lõi của BA.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A sponsor tells the business analyst, "Just write down exactly what the customers ask for." Which BA responsibility does this request overlook?
option_A: Analyzing whether stated requests meet the real business need
option_B: Keeping every requirements document under strict version control
option_C: Getting formal sign-off on documented requirements
option_D: Recording requirements in the agreed template
explanation_en: A BA does not just take notes; the BA must analyze to find the underlying business need behind the stated request.
explanation_vi: BA không chỉ ghi chép; BA phải phân tích để tìm nhu cầu thật (underlying business need) đằng sau yêu cầu được nói ra.
in_short_en: A BA analyzes stated requests to uncover the real business need, not just transcribes them.
in_short_vi: BA phân tích các yêu cầu được nêu để tìm nhu cầu kinh doanh thật, không chỉ chép lại.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which TWO activities belong to the business analyst rather than the project manager? (Select two)
option_A: Tracking the project's cost variance against the baseline
option_B: Developing and maintaining the project schedule baseline
option_C: Assessing organizational readiness for the solution
option_D: Defining acceptance criteria with stakeholders
option_E: Negotiating team resource assignments with functional managers
explanation_en: The BA handles the product or solution side: acceptance criteria and the organizational readiness assessment.
explanation_vi: BA lo phần sản phẩm/giải pháp: tiêu chí chấp nhận (acceptance criteria) và đánh giá sẵn sàng của tổ chức (readiness assessment).
in_short_en: BAs own solution-focused work such as acceptance criteria and readiness; PMs own schedule, cost, and resources.
in_short_vi: BA lo phần việc về giải pháp như tiêu chí chấp nhận và mức sẵn sàng; PM lo lịch, chi phí và nguồn lực.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: During planning, both the project manager and the business analyst want to interview the same 15 stakeholders. What is the BEST way to avoid duplicate effort and stakeholder fatigue?
option_A: Run separate interviews to keep the two roles independent
option_B: Plan the interviews jointly and share one engagement approach
option_C: Have the PM run all interviews and forward the notes to the BA
option_D: Let each stakeholder choose which of the two to meet
explanation_en: The PM and BA should coordinate: agree on one stakeholder approach and plan elicitation together.
explanation_vi: PM và BA nên phối hợp: thống nhất một cách tiếp cận stakeholder và lên kế hoạch elicitation chung.
in_short_en: The PM and BA should coordinate stakeholder engagement rather than work in silos.
in_short_vi: PM và BA nên phối hợp tiếp cận stakeholder thay vì làm riêng rẽ.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Before a project is approved, the executive team asks the business analyst to help them decide whether the investment is worthwhile. Which deliverable is the BA MOST likely to contribute to?
option_A: Requirements traceability matrix
option_B: Project management plan
option_C: Business case
option_D: Project charter
explanation_en: Before the project is approved, the BA helps with the needs assessment and builds the business case.
explanation_vi: Trước khi dự án được duyệt, BA giúp đánh giá nhu cầu (needs assessment) và xây dựng tình huống kinh doanh (business case).
in_short_en: Before approval, a BA supports the needs assessment and business case.
in_short_vi: Trước khi dự án được duyệt, BA hỗ trợ đánh giá nhu cầu và lập business case.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: On a Scrum team, the business analyst discovers that two backlog items conflict with each other. Who should decide which item takes priority?
option_A: Product owner
option_B: Scrum master
option_C: Business analyst
option_D: The developers
explanation_en: The product owner (PO) decides the priority order of the product backlog; the BA analyzes and surfaces the conflict.
explanation_vi: Product owner (PO) quyết định thứ tự ưu tiên của product backlog; BA phân tích và nêu ra xung đột.
in_short_en: The business analyst surfaces the conflict, but the product owner orders the backlog.
in_short_vi: BA nêu ra xung đột, nhưng product owner sắp xếp thứ tự backlog.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement BEST describes how a business analyst works with subject matter experts (SMEs)?
option_A: The BA elicits SMEs' knowledge and confirms requirements reflect it
option_B: The SMEs prioritize the requirements that the BA has documented
option_C: The BA approves the requirements that SMEs write and submit on their own
option_D: The SMEs set the BA's elicitation schedule and its scope
explanation_en: The BA draws knowledge from subject matter experts (SMEs) and confirms that the requirements reflect that knowledge correctly.
explanation_vi: BA khai thác kiến thức từ chuyên gia nghiệp vụ (subject matter expert - SME) và xác nhận lại rằng yêu cầu phản ánh đúng kiến thức đó.
in_short_en: SMEs supply knowledge; the BA elicits, analyzes, and confirms it.
in_short_vi: SME cung cấp kiến thức; BA khơi gợi, phân tích và xác nhận lại.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which document provides the economic, financial, or social justification for addressing a business problem or opportunity?
option_A: Project charter
option_B: Benefits management plan
option_C: Business case
option_D: Strategic objectives document
explanation_en: The business case presents the rationale and feasibility of the investment.
explanation_vi: Tình huống kinh doanh (business case) trình bày lý do và tính khả thi của khoản đầu tư.
in_short_en: The business case justifies the investment.
in_short_vi: Business case biện minh cho khoản đầu tư.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.2 Q5, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: A business analyst must share the status of requirements with executives who have very little time. Which format is BEST?
option_A: A detailed 80-page requirements specification document
option_B: A concise dashboard focused on business impact
option_C: The raw requirements traceability matrix with all rows
option_D: Daily emails listing every open ticket and its status
explanation_en: Busy executives need a dashboard or a brief summary focused on business impact.
explanation_vi: Lãnh đạo bận rộn cần dashboard hoặc bản tóm tắt ngắn gọn, tập trung vào tác động (impact) kinh doanh.
in_short_en: Executives need a concise summary focused on business impact.
in_short_vi: Lãnh đạo cần bản tóm tắt ngắn gọn tập trung vào tác động kinh doanh.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A subject matter expert with critical knowledge is too busy to attend elicitation sessions. What should the BA do?
option_A: Use short, focused sessions and secure time via the manager
option_B: Ask a junior colleague of the SME to answer instead
option_C: Use only the SME's documents and skip any conversation
option_D: Escalate the SME's availability directly to the CEO
explanation_en: Use flexible techniques (short interviews, document analysis) and work with the SME's manager to secure time.
explanation_vi: Dùng kỹ thuật linh hoạt (phỏng vấn ngắn, phân tích tài liệu) và phối hợp với quản lý của SME để sắp xếp thời gian.
in_short_en: Adapt elicitation to busy SMEs and secure their time through their manager.
in_short_vi: Điều chỉnh cách khơi gợi yêu cầu cho SME bận rộn và sắp xếp thời gian qua quản lý của họ.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst must confirm 40 detailed business rules with a compliance officer who prefers to study material carefully on her own time. Which communication approach is BEST?
option_A: Present the rules to her in a large group workshop
option_B: Post the rules on the team wiki and wait for comments
option_C: Walk her through each rule during the daily stand-up
option_D: Send the rules ahead, then follow up in a short call
explanation_en: Combine sending the material for careful reading (push) with a short call to clarify (interactive), matching the stakeholder's preference.
explanation_vi: Kết hợp gửi tài liệu để đọc kỹ (push) với một cuộc gọi ngắn để làm rõ (interactive), phù hợp sở thích của stakeholder.
in_short_en: Tailor communication to the stakeholder: send material for self-review, then follow up interactively.
in_short_vi: Điều chỉnh giao tiếp theo stakeholder: gửi tài liệu để họ tự xem, rồi trao đổi trực tiếp.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Executives want to check the latest requirements status whenever they choose, without receiving more emails. Which communication method fits BEST?
option_A: Push communication through a weekly email
option_B: Pull communication through a shared dashboard
option_C: Push communication through a printed report
option_D: Interactive communication in a status meeting
explanation_en: Pull communication: recipients access information themselves when they need it, e.g., a dashboard or wiki.
explanation_vi: Giao tiếp kéo (pull communication): người nhận tự truy cập thông tin khi cần, ví dụ dashboard, wiki.
in_short_en: When people want information on their own schedule, use pull communication.
in_short_vi: Khi người nhận muốn tự chọn lúc xem thông tin, dùng giao tiếp kéo (pull).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Two department heads give conflicting requirements for the same purchase-approval workflow. What should the business analyst do FIRST?
option_A: Escalate the conflict to the sponsor for a final decision
option_B: Meet both to understand the need behind each request
option_C: Choose the requirement of the more senior department head
option_D: Document both requirements and let developers pick one
explanation_en: First the BA must understand each party's underlying need; many conflicts are resolved once the real goals are clear.
explanation_vi: Trước tiên BA cần hiểu nhu cầu gốc (underlying need) của mỗi bên; nhiều xung đột được giải quyết khi rõ mục tiêu thật.
in_short_en: First understand the underlying needs before escalating a requirements conflict.
in_short_vi: Trước khi escalate xung đột yêu cầu, hãy hiểu nhu cầu gốc của mỗi bên.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Developers keep misinterpreting a long written description of a complex discount rule with many conditions. Which technique would MOST improve shared understanding?
option_A: A stakeholder register listing everyone on the pricing team
option_B: A decision table reviewed together with the developers
option_C: A longer narrative description that repeats the rule in more detail
option_D: A RACI chart for requirement approvals
explanation_en: A decision table clearly sets out combinations of conditions and outcomes and suits complex rules well.
explanation_vi: Bảng quyết định (decision table) trình bày rõ các tổ hợp điều kiện và kết quả, rất hợp với quy tắc phức tạp.
in_short_en: Use models such as decision tables to communicate complex business rules.
in_short_vi: Dùng mô hình như bảng quyết định để truyền đạt các quy tắc nghiệp vụ phức tạp.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst joins a project with 25 stakeholders across four countries. Before elicitation begins, what should the BA analyze to plan communication?
option_A: The defect history of the current system
option_B: The project budget and its funding schedule
option_C: Their information needs, preferences, and influence
option_D: Their job titles, office locations, and reporting lines
explanation_en: Communication planning starts with stakeholder analysis: information needs, channel preferences, and level of influence.
explanation_vi: Lập kế hoạch giao tiếp bắt đầu bằng phân tích stakeholder: nhu cầu thông tin, sở thích kênh giao tiếp và mức ảnh hưởng.
in_short_en: Plan communication from each stakeholder's information needs, preferences, and influence.
in_short_vi: Lập kế hoạch giao tiếp dựa trên nhu cầu thông tin, sở thích và mức ảnh hưởng của từng stakeholder.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst is preparing to communicate an approved requirements change. Which TWO actions make the message more effective? (Select two)
option_A: Send the same technical document to everyone
option_B: Tailor the level of detail to each audience
option_C: Inform only the stakeholders who objected
option_D: Wait until the change is built before telling users
option_E: Explain how the change affects each group
explanation_en: A message is effective when it is tailored to the audience and makes the impact on them clear.
explanation_vi: Thông điệp hiệu quả khi được điều chỉnh theo người nhận và nêu rõ tác động tới họ.
in_short_en: Tailor detail to the audience and explain the impact on each group.
in_short_vi: Điều chỉnh mức chi tiết theo người nghe và giải thích tác động tới từng nhóm.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A key stakeholder has stopped attending requirements review sessions without explanation. What should the business analyst do FIRST?
option_A: Approve the requirements without the stakeholder's input
option_B: Ask the sponsor to require the stakeholder's attendance
option_C: Send the materials and treat silence as agreement
option_D: Contact the stakeholder to understand the reason
explanation_en: First talk to them directly to understand why, then adjust the approach.
explanation_vi: Trước tiên trao đổi trực tiếp để hiểu lý do, rồi mới điều chỉnh cách tiếp cận.
in_short_en: Talk to a disengaged stakeholder first to understand why.
in_short_vi: Trước tiên hãy trao đổi với stakeholder ít tham gia để hiểu lý do.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst asks about a stakeholder group: "How is their performance evaluated? Will the project's outcomes affect it? Are they needed to produce those outcomes?" Which stakeholder attribute is being analyzed?
option_A: Interest
option_B: Authority
option_C: Power
option_D: Influence
explanation_en: Questions about how the project affects them help assess a stakeholder's interest.
explanation_vi: Các câu hỏi về việc dự án ảnh hưởng tới họ thế nào giúp đánh giá mức quan tâm (interest) của stakeholder.
in_short_en: Questions about how outcomes affect a group assess stakeholder interest.
in_short_vi: Các câu hỏi về kết quả ảnh hưởng tới một nhóm thế nào là để đánh giá mức quan tâm (interest).
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.5 Q4, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: Which statement is NOT correct?
option_A: A responsibility assignment matrix shows who does what for each activity
option_B: A RACI chart should name only one accountable person per activity
option_C: The stakeholder engagement assessment matrix tracks power and interest levels
option_D: The stakeholder engagement assessment matrix records current and desired support
explanation_en: The stakeholder engagement assessment matrix compares current and desired engagement levels; it does not track power/interest.
explanation_vi: Ma trận đánh giá mức tham gia (stakeholder engagement assessment matrix) so sánh mức tham gia hiện tại và mong muốn, không theo dõi power/interest.
in_short_en: The engagement assessment matrix compares current and desired engagement; power and interest go on a grid.
in_short_vi: Ma trận đánh giá mức tham gia so sánh mức hiện tại với mong muốn; quyền lực và mức quan tâm được thể hiện trên lưới.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.5 Q8, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: During execution, a stakeholder originally classified as low power and low interest gains significant influence in the organization. What should the project manager do NEXT?
option_A: Keep the current plan because execution is already underway
option_B: Re-evaluate the stakeholder and adjust the engagement approach
option_C: Limit the stakeholder's involvement to avoid disruption
option_D: Engage the stakeholder only at major project milestones
explanation_en: Stakeholder analysis is ongoing; when power changes, reassess and adjust the engagement approach.
explanation_vi: Phân tích stakeholder là việc liên tục; khi quyền lực thay đổi, cần đánh giá lại và điều chỉnh cách tiếp cận.
in_short_en: Reassess stakeholders when their power or interest changes and adapt engagement.
in_short_vi: Đánh giá lại stakeholder khi quyền lực hay mức quan tâm thay đổi và điều chỉnh cách tiếp cận.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.5 Q15, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: "The system shall allow customers to save items to a wish list." How is this requirement BEST classified?
option_A: Business requirement (high-level need)
option_B: Transition requirement (temporary need)
option_C: Solution requirement (functional)
option_D: Project requirement (delivery condition)
explanation_en: This is a functional solution requirement: it describes a feature or behavior the product must have.
explanation_vi: Đây là yêu cầu giải pháp dạng chức năng (functional solution requirement): mô tả tính năng hoặc hành vi mà sản phẩm phải có.
in_short_en: A system capability like a wish list is a functional solution requirement.
in_short_vi: Một năng lực của hệ thống như danh sách yêu thích là yêu cầu giải pháp dạng chức năng.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement is a requirement rather than a project task?
option_A: Hold a design review with the logistics team on May 3
option_B: Update the risk register at the end of each sprint
option_C: Assign two testers to the regression test cycle
option_D: Customers must be able to see an order's delivery status
explanation_en: A requirement describes a condition or capability the solution must have; a task is work the project must do.
explanation_vi: Yêu cầu (requirement) mô tả điều kiện hay năng lực giải pháp phải có; task là việc dự án phải làm.
in_short_en: A requirement states a needed capability; a task is work the project performs.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu nêu năng lực cần có; task là công việc dự án thực hiện.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement is a business requirement?
option_A: Pages shall load within 2 seconds at peak traffic
option_B: The system shall email a confirmation after checkout
option_C: Migrate legacy customer data before go-live
option_D: Reduce order-processing costs by 15% within one year
explanation_en: A business requirement states goals or outcomes at the organizational level.
explanation_vi: Yêu cầu kinh doanh (business requirement) nêu mục tiêu, kết quả ở cấp tổ chức.
in_short_en: An organization-level goal such as cutting costs 15% is a business requirement.
in_short_vi: Mục tiêu cấp tổ chức như giảm 15% chi phí là yêu cầu kinh doanh (business requirement).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which of the following is a non-functional requirement?
option_A: Users can reset their own password from the login page by email
option_B: The system calculates sales tax on each order line
option_C: Pages load within 2 seconds with 1,000 concurrent users
option_D: Users can export any report to an Excel spreadsheet
explanation_en: A page loading in 2 seconds with 1,000 concurrent users is a non-functional (performance) requirement: it describes how well the system performs.
explanation_vi: Trang tải trong 2 giây với 1.000 người dùng (user) đồng thời là yêu cầu phi chức năng (hiệu năng): nó mô tả hệ thống hoạt động tốt đến mức nào.
in_short_en: Performance targets such as page load time are non-functional requirements.
in_short_vi: Mục tiêu hiệu năng như thời gian tải trang là yêu cầu phi chức năng.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Nurses say the medication-ordering process "works fine," yet errors keep occurring. The business analyst suspects they use workarounds they no longer notice. Which elicitation technique is BEST?
option_A: Observation (job shadowing)
option_B: Online survey of all nurses
option_C: Analysis of procedure documents
option_D: Focus group with ward managers
explanation_en: Observation reveals how the work is actually done and the workarounds users no longer notice enough to mention.
explanation_vi: Quan sát (observation) phát hiện cách làm thực tế và các thủ thuật mà người dùng không còn để ý để kể ra.
in_short_en: To uncover unnoticed workarounds, observe the work directly.
in_short_vi: Để phát hiện các thủ thuật người dùng không để ý, hãy quan sát trực tiếp công việc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst needs input from 2,500 franchise owners in 12 countries within three weeks. Which technique fits BEST?
option_A: Facilitated workshops
option_B: Survey or questionnaire
option_C: Job shadowing in each country
option_D: One-on-one interviews
explanation_en: A survey collects opinions quickly from many people in many locations.
explanation_vi: Khảo sát (survey) thu thập ý kiến nhanh từ số đông ở nhiều nơi.
in_short_en: Large, dispersed audiences and short timelines call for surveys.
in_short_vi: Đối tượng đông, phân tán và thời gian ngắn thì dùng khảo sát (survey).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst documents how invoices are processed today and how they should be processed after automation, then lists the capabilities needed to close the difference. Which technique is this?
option_A: Gap analysis
option_B: Root cause analysis
option_C: SWOT analysis
option_D: Benchmarking
explanation_en: Gap analysis compares the current state with the desired state to identify the capabilities that must be added.
explanation_vi: Phân tích khoảng cách (gap analysis) so sánh trạng thái hiện tại với trạng thái mong muốn để xác định năng lực cần bổ sung.
in_short_en: Comparing current and future states to find needed capabilities is gap analysis.
in_short_vi: So sánh trạng thái hiện tại và tương lai để tìm năng lực cần có là phân tích khoảng cách (gap analysis).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A team has 40 candidate requirements and needs to narrow them down quickly. Each participant gets a fixed number of votes to spread across the items, and the items with the most votes are prioritized. Which technique is this?
option_A: Benchmarking
option_B: Delphi technique
option_C: Autocratic decision making
option_D: Multivoting
explanation_en: Multivoting (dot voting) gives each person a number of votes to spread across items, to quickly narrow and rank a long list.
explanation_vi: Bỏ phiếu nhiều lần (multivoting, dot voting) cho mỗi người một số phiếu để phân bổ cho các mục, dùng để thu hẹp và xếp hạng nhanh một danh sách dài.
in_short_en: Giving each participant several votes to narrow a list is multivoting.
in_short_vi: Cho mỗi người nhiều phiếu để thu hẹp danh sách là bỏ phiếu nhiều lần (multivoting).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Store managers struggle to describe what they want from a new stock-count app until they see something concrete. What should the business analyst do?
option_A: Have developers build the full app and adjust it later
option_B: Wait until the managers can write their own requirements
option_C: Build a low-fidelity prototype and gather their feedback
option_D: Send a detailed questionnaire about the desired features
explanation_en: Prototyping lets users give feedback on a concrete model when requirements are hard to describe in words.
explanation_vi: Làm mẫu (prototyping) giúp người dùng phản hồi trên mô hình cụ thể khi khó mô tả yêu cầu bằng lời.
in_short_en: When users cannot describe needs, prototype and gather feedback.
in_short_vi: Khi người dùng không mô tả được nhu cầu, hãy làm prototype và lấy phản hồi.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Before detailed elicitation, a business analyst wants a one-page view that shows the new system as a single box, with the external systems and user groups around it and the data flowing in and out. Which model fits?
option_A: Use case diagram
option_B: Context diagram
option_C: Organizational chart
option_D: Process flow diagram
explanation_en: A context diagram shows the solution boundary, external entities, and the data flowing in and out.
explanation_vi: Sơ đồ ngữ cảnh (context diagram) thể hiện ranh giới giải pháp, các thực thể bên ngoài và dữ liệu vào ra.
in_short_en: System boundary, external entities, and data flows are shown in a context diagram.
in_short_vi: Ranh giới hệ thống, thực thể bên ngoài và luồng dữ liệu được thể hiện trong context diagram.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement describes PRODUCT scope rather than PROJECT scope?
option_A: The project will train 50 support agents before launch
option_B: The vendor will deliver the design files by June 1
option_C: The app lets users split a bill among up to 10 friends
option_D: The team will run three rounds of usability testing
explanation_en: Product scope: the features and functions of the product. Project scope: the work needed to create the product.
explanation_vi: Phạm vi sản phẩm (product scope): tính năng và chức năng của sản phẩm. Phạm vi dự án (project scope): công việc cần làm để tạo ra sản phẩm.
in_short_en: Product scope is features and functions; project scope is the work to deliver them.
in_short_vi: Phạm vi sản phẩm là tính năng và chức năng; phạm vi dự án là công việc để tạo ra chúng.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A stakeholder states the requirement: "The system should be fast." What should the business analyst do?
option_A: Make it measurable and confirm it with the stakeholder
option_B: Leave it as written, since the stakeholder's intent is clear
option_C: Let the developers interpret what fast should mean
option_D: Add "fast" to the glossary with a general definition
explanation_en: Rewrite it as a measurable, testable requirement (e.g., 95% of pages load in under 2 seconds) and confirm it with the stakeholder.
explanation_vi: Viết lại thành yêu cầu đo lường và kiểm thử được (ví dụ 95% trang tải dưới 2 giây) và xác nhận lại với stakeholder.
in_short_en: Rewrite vague requirements to be measurable and confirm them with the stakeholder.
in_short_vi: Viết lại yêu cầu mơ hồ thành dạng đo lường được và xác nhận lại với stakeholder.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A new warehouse system must exchange data with the existing billing and shipping systems. Which elicitation technique helps the business analyst identify requirements for these connections?
option_A: Interface analysis
option_B: Focus group session
option_C: Competitive benchmarking
option_D: Job shadowing
explanation_en: Interface analysis defines the requirements for data exchange between systems or between a system and its users.
explanation_vi: Phân tích giao diện (interface analysis) xác định yêu cầu trao đổi dữ liệu giữa các hệ thống hoặc giữa hệ thống với người dùng.
in_short_en: Use interface analysis to define requirements for connections between systems.
in_short_vi: Dùng phân tích giao diện (interface analysis) để xác định yêu cầu về kết nối giữa các hệ thống.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A healthcare project must comply with a 200-page data privacy regulation. Which technique should the business analyst use FIRST to identify the compliance requirements?
option_A: Focus group
option_B: Brainstorming session
option_C: Document analysis
option_D: Observation of staff
explanation_en: Document analysis is an efficient way to draw requirements from existing regulations, policies, and contracts.
explanation_vi: Phân tích tài liệu (document analysis) là cách hiệu quả để rút ra yêu cầu từ quy định, chính sách, hợp đồng có sẵn.
in_short_en: Use document analysis to extract requirements from regulations and existing documents.
in_short_vi: Dùng phân tích tài liệu (document analysis) để rút yêu cầu từ quy định và tài liệu có sẵn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: After a requirements workshop, the business analyst writes up the notes and sends them back to participants to check for accuracy and gaps. Which elicitation activity is this?
option_A: Confirm elicitation results
option_B: Prepare for elicitation
option_C: Conduct elicitation
option_D: Determine the elicitation approach
explanation_en: Confirm elicitation results: check the information gathered with the participants.
explanation_vi: Xác nhận kết quả elicitation (confirm elicitation results): kiểm tra lại thông tin thu được với người tham gia.
in_short_en: Sending notes back for accuracy checks is confirming elicitation results.
in_short_vi: Gửi lại ghi chú để kiểm tra độ chính xác là bước xác nhận kết quả khơi gợi yêu cầu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Stakeholders of an online store request "a faster checkout page." Analytics show that most customers abandon their carts at the step where shipping fees appear. What should the business analyst do NEXT?
option_A: Add the faster checkout page to the backlog as requested
option_B: Analyze why customers abandon before defining a solution
option_C: Ask developers to estimate the faster checkout page
option_D: Survey customers about their preferred payment methods
explanation_en: The BA should find the root cause before settling on a solution; the data suggests the problem may be shipping fees, not speed.
explanation_vi: BA nên tìm nguyên nhân gốc (root cause) trước khi chốt giải pháp; dữ liệu cho thấy vấn đề có thể là phí vận chuyển, không phải tốc độ.
in_short_en: Analyze the problem and its root cause before committing to a requested solution.
in_short_vi: Phân tích vấn đề và nguyên nhân gốc trước khi cam kết với giải pháp được yêu cầu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which requirement is written BEST?
option_A: The system should respond quickly whenever customers check order status
option_B: The system shall make order lookups easy and intuitive for every user
option_C: The system shall provide industry-leading order tracking at all times
option_D: The system shall show order status within 2 seconds for 95% of requests
explanation_en: A good requirement must be measurable and testable.
explanation_vi: Yêu cầu tốt phải đo lường được và kiểm thử được (measurable, testable).
in_short_en: Good requirements are specific, measurable, and testable.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu tốt phải cụ thể, đo lường được và kiểm thử được.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A team has more candidate requirements than it can deliver in the first release. Which TWO techniques help prioritize them? (Select two)
option_A: Interface analysis
option_B: Weighted ranking
option_C: Document analysis
option_D: MoSCoW analysis
explanation_en: MoSCoW and weighted ranking are requirement prioritization techniques.
explanation_vi: MoSCoW và xếp hạng có trọng số (weighted ranking) là kỹ thuật ưu tiên yêu cầu.
in_short_en: MoSCoW and weighted ranking prioritize requirements; the others elicit them.
in_short_vi: MoSCoW và xếp hạng có trọng số dùng để ưu tiên yêu cầu; các kỹ thuật còn lại dùng để khơi gợi yêu cầu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst must describe how a customer, a payment gateway, and the order system interact to complete a purchase, including alternative flows when payment fails. Which model is MOST suitable?
option_A: Ecosystem map
option_B: User story
option_C: Use case
option_D: Context diagram
explanation_en: A use case describes the sequence of interactions between an actor and the system to achieve a goal, including the main flow and alternative flows.
explanation_vi: Use case mô tả chuỗi tương tác giữa actor và hệ thống để đạt mục tiêu, gồm luồng chính và luồng thay thế (alternative flows).
in_short_en: Use cases describe step-by-step interactions, including alternative and exception flows.
in_short_vi: Use case mô tả tương tác từng bước, gồm cả luồng thay thế và ngoại lệ.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the main purpose of a needs assessment, which often comes before a business case?
option_A: To set the project's budget limits and to identify its funding sources
option_B: To assess current capabilities and identify viable solution options
option_C: To assess team members' skills and assign them project roles
option_D: To identify and rate the project's individual risks
explanation_en: A needs assessment examines the internal and external environment and current capabilities to identify viable options.
explanation_vi: Đánh giá nhu cầu (needs assessment) xem xét môi trường bên trong, bên ngoài và năng lực hiện tại để xác định các phương án khả thi.
in_short_en: A needs assessment analyzes the current state and capabilities to find viable solution options.
in_short_vi: Đánh giá nhu cầu phân tích trạng thái và năng lực hiện tại để tìm các phương án giải pháp khả thi.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.2 Q15, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: Which type of requirement is at the highest level?
option_A: Stakeholder requirements
option_B: Solution requirements
option_C: Business requirements
option_D: Transition requirements
explanation_en: Business requirements are at the highest level: the organization's goals and reasons.
explanation_vi: Yêu cầu kinh doanh (business requirements) ở mức cao nhất: mục tiêu và lý do của tổ chức.
in_short_en: Business requirements sit at the top of the requirements hierarchy.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu kinh doanh nằm ở cấp cao nhất trong hệ thống phân cấp yêu cầu.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.4 Q4, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: Which statement INCORRECTLY describes a requirement type?
option_A: Functional requirements describe the behaviors and information the solution must manage
option_B: Solution requirements describe capabilities and qualities that meet stakeholder requirements
option_C: Non-functional requirements state the goals and outcomes that explain why a change was initiated
option_D: Transition requirements are temporary conditions needed to move to the future state
explanation_en: Describing why a change is being undertaken is business requirements, not non-functional requirements.
explanation_vi: Mô tả lý do khởi động thay đổi là business requirements, không phải non-functional requirements.
in_short_en: Goals and reasons for change are business requirements; non-functional requirements describe quality attributes.
in_short_vi: Mục tiêu và lý do thay đổi là yêu cầu kinh doanh; yêu cầu phi chức năng mô tả thuộc tính chất lượng.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.4 Q5, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: A food-delivery app adds live courier tracking on a map. Customers never asked for it, but satisfaction jumps once it appears. In the Kano model, what type of feature is this?
option_A: Indifferent
option_B: Performance (one-dimensional)
option_C: Excitement (delighter)
option_D: Basic (must-be)
explanation_en: Excitement features (delighters): customers do not expect them, but are very pleased when they are present.
explanation_vi: Tính năng tạo hứng thú (excitement/delighter): khách không mong đợi, nhưng có thì rất hài lòng.
in_short_en: Unexpected features that delight customers are Kano excitement features.
in_short_vi: Tính năng bất ngờ làm khách hàng thích thú là tính năng excitement trong mô hình Kano.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: An executive asks for exact delivery dates for every feature on an agile product roadmap for the next 18 months. What is the BEST response?
option_A: Commit to exact dates for every feature on the roadmap
option_B: Give exact dates for the next quarter and nothing beyond it
option_C: Share the full backlog with story-point estimates instead
option_D: Give near-term detail and ranges for later items
explanation_en: Explain that the further out the roadmap goes, the less precise it is; give detail for the near phase and forecast ranges for later phases.
explanation_vi: Giải thích rằng roadmap càng xa càng kém chính xác; đưa chi tiết cho giai đoạn (phase) gần và khoảng dự báo (forecast) cho giai đoạn sau.
in_short_en: Roadmaps get less precise further out; give ranges for later items.
in_short_vi: Roadmap càng xa càng kém chính xác; hãy đưa khoảng thời gian cho các hạng mục về sau.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A new product manager inherits a 40-page feature list. Executives want to see how the product will evolve over the next year. Which artifact should the product manager create?
option_A: Requirements traceability matrix
option_B: Product roadmap
option_C: Release burndown chart
option_D: Product backlog
explanation_en: A product roadmap shows the direction and evolution of the product over time.
explanation_vi: Lộ trình sản phẩm (product roadmap) cho thấy định hướng và sự phát triển của sản phẩm theo thời gian.
in_short_en: A product roadmap shows how a product will evolve over time.
in_short_vi: Product roadmap cho thấy sản phẩm sẽ phát triển thế nào theo thời gian.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement BEST distinguishes a product roadmap from a product backlog?
option_A: A roadmap shows direction over time; a backlog lists detailed work
option_B: A roadmap is owned by developers; a backlog is owned by executives
option_C: A roadmap lists detailed work; a backlog shows direction over time
option_D: A roadmap is fixed once approved; a backlog changes every sprint
explanation_en: Roadmap: strategic direction over time. Backlog: a detailed, ordered list of work items.
explanation_vi: Roadmap: định hướng chiến lược theo thời gian. Backlog: danh sách hạng mục công việc chi tiết đã sắp thứ tự.
in_short_en: The roadmap shows strategic direction; the backlog holds the detailed, ordered work.
in_short_vi: Roadmap thể hiện định hướng chiến lược; backlog chứa công việc chi tiết đã sắp thứ tự.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Market conditions for a new fitness app are highly uncertain. How should the product team structure its roadmap?
option_A: Around themes and outcomes, detailed only for the near term
option_B: Around each sprint's dates and the team's capacity
option_C: Around individual user stories ordered by their size
option_D: Around fixed feature dates committed for the next two years
explanation_en: Under high uncertainty, the roadmap should be organized by themes and outcomes, detailed for the near term and general for the longer term.
explanation_vi: Khi bất định cao, roadmap nên theo chủ đề và kết quả (themes, outcomes), chi tiết cho giai đoạn gần, khái quát cho xa.
in_short_en: Under uncertainty, build an outcome-based roadmap with detail only for the near term.
in_short_vi: Khi bất định cao, xây roadmap theo kết quả và chỉ chi tiết cho giai đoạn gần.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A competitor launches a similar product, and the sponsor shifts strategy toward a new customer segment. What should happen to the product roadmap?
option_A: Archive it and rely only on the sprint backlog from now on
option_B: Keep it unchanged because it was already approved
option_C: Revise it to reflect the new strategy and share it
option_D: Replace it with a detailed baseline schedule
explanation_en: The roadmap is a living document: update it when strategy changes and communicate it again to stakeholders.
explanation_vi: Roadmap là tài liệu sống: cập nhật khi chiến lược thay đổi và truyền đạt lại cho stakeholder.
in_short_en: Update and re-communicate the roadmap when strategy changes.
in_short_vi: Cập nhật và truyền đạt lại roadmap khi chiến lược thay đổi.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which TWO items typically appear on a product roadmap? (Select two)
option_A: Notes from daily stand-up meetings
option_B: Strategic themes or goals
option_C: Planned releases or milestones
option_D: Individual task assignments for each developer
option_E: Detailed test scripts for each feature
explanation_en: A roadmap usually contains releases or milestones, strategic themes or goals, and time frames.
explanation_vi: Roadmap thường có: các bản phát hành/mốc, chủ đề chiến lược hoặc mục tiêu, khung thời gian.
in_short_en: Roadmaps show releases, milestones, and strategic themes, not execution details.
in_short_vi: Roadmap thể hiện các bản phát hành, mốc và chủ đề chiến lược, không phải chi tiết thực thi.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A product manager is presenting the product roadmap to the sales team. What should the presentation emphasize?
option_A: Defect counts from the previous release
option_B: Customer value and timing of upcoming capabilities
option_C: The technical architecture behind each component
option_D: Story point estimates for every item in the backlog
explanation_en: Tailor the roadmap to the audience: the sales team needs to know the value for customers and the expected timing.
explanation_vi: Điều chỉnh roadmap theo người xem: đội bán hàng cần biết giá trị cho khách hàng và thời điểm dự kiến.
in_short_en: Tailor the roadmap to the audience; sales needs customer value and timing.
in_short_vi: Điều chỉnh roadmap theo người xem; đội bán hàng cần giá trị cho khách hàng và thời điểm.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Late in a predictive project, a stakeholder introduces a new requirement. What should the business analyst do?
option_A: Add it directly to the requirements document as stated
option_B: Analyze its impact and route it through change control
option_C: Reject it outright because the scope is already approved
option_D: Ask the developers whether it can fit before deciding
explanation_en: The BA analyzes the impact (using traceability), then routes the new requirement through the change control process.
explanation_vi: BA phân tích tác động (dùng traceability), rồi đưa yêu cầu mới qua quy trình (process) change control.
in_short_en: Late requirements in predictive projects go through impact analysis and change control.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu đến muộn trong dự án predictive phải qua phân tích tác động và kiểm soát thay đổi.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst works on an agile e-commerce team. The Product Owner asks for help getting stories "ready". What is the BA's BEST contribution?
option_A: Join refinement, clarify needs, and help write acceptance criteria
option_B: Take over the Product Owner's backlog prioritization decisions
option_C: Write a full business requirements document before Sprint 1
option_D: Write all the user stories alone and hand them to the team
explanation_en: The BA takes part in refinement, clarifies needs with stakeholders, and helps write acceptance criteria; the PO still decides the priority order.
explanation_vi: BA tham gia refinement, làm rõ nhu cầu với stakeholder và hỗ trợ viết acceptance criteria; PO vẫn quyết định thứ tự ưu tiên (priority order).
in_short_en: In agile, the BA supports refinement and acceptance criteria while the PO prioritizes.
in_short_vi: Trong agile, BA hỗ trợ refinement và acceptance criteria còn PO quyết định ưu tiên.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: An organization is moving its business analysis practice from a predictive to an adaptive approach. Which change is MOST expected?
option_A: A larger, more detailed requirements document written upfront
option_B: A fixed requirements baseline approved before the first iteration
option_C: Just-in-time elaboration with lighter documentation
option_D: Less stakeholder involvement once development has started
explanation_en: When moving to adaptive, the BA elaborates requirements just in time, collaborates continuously with the PO and team, and uses lighter documentation.
explanation_vi: Khi chuyển sang adaptive, BA chi tiết hóa yêu cầu just-in-time, cộng tác liên tục với PO và team, và dùng tài liệu (documentation) nhẹ hơn.
in_short_en: Adaptive BA means just-in-time elaboration and lighter documentation.
in_short_vi: BA trong adaptive làm rõ yêu cầu ngay khi cần và dùng tài liệu gọn nhẹ hơn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: How does business analysis typically differ between a predictive and an adaptive approach?
option_A: Predictive defines most requirements up front; adaptive refines them just in time
option_B: Predictive has no requirements baseline; adaptive keeps a fixed baseline
option_C: Both approaches finalize all requirements before any design begins
option_D: Predictive refines requirements in each iteration; adaptive defines them all up front
explanation_en: Predictive: most requirements are defined early and baselined. Adaptive: requirements are elaborated progressively, just in time.
explanation_vi: Predictive: phần lớn yêu cầu được xác định sớm và đưa vào baseline. Adaptive: yêu cầu được làm rõ dần, ngay trước khi cần (just in time).
in_short_en: Predictive BA defines requirements early; adaptive BA elaborates them just in time.
in_short_vi: BA trong predictive xác định yêu cầu sớm; BA trong adaptive làm rõ yêu cầu ngay khi cần.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A program builds new smart-meter hardware using a predictive approach and the companion mobile app using Scrum. How should the business analyst manage requirements?
option_A: Freeze all app and hardware needs before any build starts
option_B: Use one requirements baseline for both, refined monthly
option_C: Baseline hardware needs; manage app needs in a backlog
option_D: Write user stories for both the hardware and the app
explanation_en: In a hybrid model, the BA tailors requirements management by part: a baseline for the predictive part and a backlog for the adaptive part.
explanation_vi: Với mô hình lai (hybrid), BA điều chỉnh cách quản lý yêu cầu theo từng phần: baseline cho phần predictive, backlog cho phần adaptive.
in_short_en: In a hybrid program, tailor BA practices: baseline the predictive part, use a backlog for the adaptive part.
in_short_vi: Trong chương trình hybrid, điều chỉnh cách làm BA: baseline cho phần predictive, backlog cho phần adaptive.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: An agile team asks the business analyst how much requirements documentation it should produce. What is the BEST guidance?
option_A: None, since conversations replace all documentation
option_B: Whatever level of documentation the previous waterfall project produced
option_C: Just enough to build shared understanding and meet compliance
option_D: A full specification for every story before the first sprint
explanation_en: Agile favors "just enough" documentation: enough for shared understanding and to meet regulations.
explanation_vi: Agile ưu tiên tài liệu "vừa đủ" (just enough): đủ để hiểu chung và đáp ứng quy định.
in_short_en: In agile, document just enough for shared understanding and compliance.
in_short_vi: Trong agile, viết tài liệu vừa đủ để cùng hiểu và đáp ứng quy định.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In an adaptive approach, when are requirements typically validated with stakeholders?
option_A: Only at the end, during final acceptance testing
option_B: Continuously, through reviews of each working increment
option_C: Whenever the change control board meets
option_D: Once, during a formal sign-off held before development starts
explanation_en: In adaptive, requirements are validated continuously by reviewing working increments (e.g., at the sprint review).
explanation_vi: Trong adaptive, yêu cầu được xác nhận liên tục qua việc xem xét các increment chạy được (ví dụ sprint review).
in_short_en: Adaptive teams validate requirements continuously through increment reviews.
in_short_vi: Đội adaptive xác nhận yêu cầu liên tục qua việc xem xét các increment.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In a predictive project, when does the most intensive requirements elicitation typically occur?
option_A: After deployment, during benefits realization
option_B: Early, before the scope baseline is approved
option_C: Continuously, at the start of every iteration
option_D: Late, during final acceptance testing
explanation_en: In predictive, elicitation is concentrated early, to define the scope before the scope baseline is approved.
explanation_vi: Trong predictive, elicitation tập trung ở giai đoạn đầu để xác định phạm vi trước khi phê duyệt scope baseline.
in_short_en: Predictive projects elicit most requirements early, before the scope baseline.
in_short_vi: Dự án predictive khơi gợi phần lớn yêu cầu từ sớm, trước khi có scope baseline.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: How is requirements traceability commonly achieved in an adaptive project?
option_A: By linking stories to epics and acceptance tests in the backlog tool
option_B: By keeping a signed traceability matrix that is never updated after approval
option_C: By tracing requirements only just before the final release
option_D: By tracing only to epics and never down to tests
explanation_en: In agile, traceability is usually lightweight: linking stories to epics, objectives, and acceptance tests right in the backlog tool.
explanation_vi: Trong agile, truy vết thường thực hiện nhẹ nhàng: liên kết story với epic, mục tiêu và acceptance test ngay trong công cụ backlog.
in_short_en: Adaptive teams trace requirements by linking backlog items to epics and tests in their tools.
in_short_vi: Đội adaptive truy vết yêu cầu bằng cách liên kết hạng mục backlog với epic và test ngay trong công cụ.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which of the following is a transition requirement?
option_A: The system shall be available 99.9% of the time each month
option_B: The system shall calculate shipping fees based on parcel weight
option_C: Convert ten years of customer records into the new format before go-live
option_D: Increase online sales by 20% within the next financial year
explanation_en: A transition requirement is a temporary need for moving from the current state to the future state.
explanation_vi: Yêu cầu chuyển đổi (transition requirement): nhu cầu tạm thời để chuyển từ trạng thái hiện tại sang tương lai.
in_short_en: Temporary needs such as data conversion are transition requirements.
in_short_vi: Nhu cầu tạm thời như chuyển đổi dữ liệu là yêu cầu chuyển đổi (transition requirement).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: For the story "As a shopper, I want to save my cart so that I can buy later," which is the BEST acceptance criterion?
option_A: The saved cart should load quickly and be simple and easy for every shopper to use
option_B: The saved-cart code has passed peer review and all automated unit tests
option_C: The development team will complete the saved-cart feature within this sprint
option_D: Given items in the cart, when she signs in again later, the items are still there
explanation_en: Good acceptance criteria must be specific and testable, often written in the Given-When-Then format.
explanation_vi: Tiêu chí chấp nhận (acceptance criteria) tốt phải cụ thể và kiểm thử được, thường viết theo dạng Given-When-Then.
in_short_en: Acceptance criteria are specific and testable, often written as Given-When-Then.
in_short_vi: Tiêu chí chấp nhận phải cụ thể, kiểm thử được, thường viết theo dạng Given-When-Then.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Confirming that requirements and the solution actually meet the stakeholders' business needs is called:
option_A: Verification
option_B: Validation
option_C: Elicitation
option_D: Traceability
explanation_en: Validation confirms that the requirements and the solution actually meet the stakeholders' business need (doing the right thing).
explanation_vi: Validation là xác nhận yêu cầu và giải pháp (solution) thực sự đáp ứng nhu cầu kinh doanh (business need) của stakeholder (làm đúng thứ cần làm).
in_short_en: Confirming the solution meets business needs is validation.
in_short_vi: Xác nhận giải pháp đáp ứng nhu cầu kinh doanh là validation.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: After deployment, users complain that the solution does not solve their business problem, even though every documented requirement was met. What is the MOST likely cause?
option_A: Poor coding practices used by the development team
option_B: Insufficient tools for automated testing of the solution
option_C: Acceptance tests did not cover enough edge cases
option_D: Requirements were not validated against the business need
explanation_en: A solution that meets every documented requirement but does not solve the business problem shows the requirements were not validated against real needs.
explanation_vi: Giải pháp (solution) đáp ứng mọi yêu cầu đã ghi nhưng không giải quyết vấn đề kinh doanh cho thấy yêu cầu chưa được validate với nhu cầu thực tế.
in_short_en: A solution that misses the business problem points to unvalidated requirements.
in_short_vi: Giải pháp không giải quyết được vấn đề kinh doanh cho thấy yêu cầu chưa được validate.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Before a planned release, the requirements traceability matrix shows that two "Must have" requirements have no passed acceptance tests. The product owner still wants to release on schedule. What should the business analyst recommend?
option_A: Release as planned and fix the two gaps in a later release
option_B: Release, and let support handle issues with the two features
option_C: Treat it as not ready and agree next steps with the PO
option_D: Downgrade the two requirements to Should have so the release can go ahead
explanation_en: The product is not ready to release: the BA presents the gaps in the RTM so the PO and stakeholders can decide to complete them or formally adjust the scope before release.
explanation_vi: Sản phẩm chưa sẵn sàng bàn giao: BA trình bày các khoảng trống trong RTM để PO và stakeholder quyết định hoàn thành, hoặc chính thức điều chỉnh phạm vi trước khi release.
in_short_en: Unmet Must-have requirements mean the product is not ready to release.
in_short_vi: Còn yêu cầu Must have chưa đạt nghĩa là sản phẩm chưa sẵn sàng phát hành.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: At a sprint review, stakeholders see a new shipping-label feature. It meets all its acceptance criteria, but warehouse staff say it slows down their packing. What should happen NEXT?
option_A: Close the feature because every acceptance criterion was met
option_B: Send the complaint to the change control board
option_C: Reject the increment because the users are unhappy
option_D: Capture the feedback as new or updated backlog items
explanation_en: Feedback from the sprint review goes into the product backlog for the PO to prioritize.
explanation_vi: Phản hồi ở sprint review được đưa vào product backlog để PO sắp xếp ưu tiên.
in_short_en: Feedback from a sprint review becomes new or updated product backlog items.
in_short_vi: Phản hồi từ sprint review trở thành hạng mục mới hoặc được cập nhật trong product backlog.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which activity is requirements VERIFICATION rather than requirements VALIDATION?
option_A: Confirming that the solution meets the business need
option_B: Measuring the benefits after the solution is deployed
option_C: Checking that a requirement is clear, testable, and consistent
option_D: Asking users whether the delivered feature actually solves their problem
explanation_en: Verification: the requirement is written correctly and meets quality standards. Validation: the requirement or solution meets the real business need.
explanation_vi: Kiểm tra (verification): yêu cầu được viết đúng và đạt chất lượng. Xác nhận (validation): yêu cầu/giải pháp đáp ứng đúng nhu cầu kinh doanh.
in_short_en: Verification checks requirement quality; validation checks that it meets the business need.
in_short_vi: Verification kiểm tra chất lượng của yêu cầu; validation kiểm tra yêu cầu có đáp ứng nhu cầu kinh doanh.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Who should primarily perform user acceptance testing (UAT)?
option_A: The project sponsor working alone
option_B: The developers who designed and built the feature
option_C: Business users or their representatives
option_D: An external quality auditor
explanation_en: User acceptance testing (UAT) is performed by business users or their representatives.
explanation_vi: Kiểm thử chấp nhận của người dùng (user acceptance testing - UAT) do người dùng nghiệp vụ hoặc đại diện của họ thực hiện.
in_short_en: UAT is performed by business users or their representatives.
in_short_vi: UAT do người dùng nghiệp vụ hoặc đại diện của họ thực hiện.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A self-service portal was expected to cut support calls by 30%. Six months after launch, calls have dropped by only 5%. What should the business analyst do?
option_A: Keep adding new portal features until support calls drop by 30%
option_B: Close the matter because the portal was delivered on time
option_C: Evaluate the solution's performance and investigate the gap
option_D: Report success, since customers have adopted the portal
explanation_en: Solution evaluation: compare actual results with the expected benefits and find the cause of the gap.
explanation_vi: Đánh giá giải pháp (solution evaluation): so sánh kết quả thực tế với lợi ích kỳ vọng và tìm nguyên nhân chênh lệch.
in_short_en: When benefits fall short, evaluate solution performance and analyze the gap.
in_short_vi: Khi lợi ích không đạt, đánh giá hiệu quả giải pháp và phân tích khoảng chênh lệch.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A story meets all of its acceptance criteria, but the code has not been peer-reviewed, which the team's Definition of Done requires. What is the status of the story?
option_A: Done, if the product owner chooses to accept it
option_B: Not done, because the Definition of Done is not met
option_C: Done, because the acceptance criteria were satisfied
option_D: Not done, because the sprint has not ended yet
explanation_en: A story is "Done" only when it meets both its own acceptance criteria and the team's shared Definition of Done (DoD).
explanation_vi: Một story chỉ "Done" khi đạt cả acceptance criteria riêng của nó và Definition of Done (DoD) chung của đội.
in_short_en: A story is done only when it meets both its acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done.
in_short_vi: Story chỉ hoàn thành khi đạt cả acceptance criteria và Definition of Done.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: At the sprint review, a product owner is deciding whether to accept a completed feature. Which TWO things should guide the decision? (Select two)
option_A: The story's acceptance criteria
option_B: The exact wording of the project charter
option_C: The team's Definition of Done
option_D: The number of hours the team worked
option_E: Whether the story finished within its original estimate
explanation_en: Features are accepted based on the acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done.
explanation_vi: Chấp nhận tính năng dựa trên acceptance criteria và Definition of Done.
in_short_en: Acceptance is based on acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done.
in_short_vi: Việc chấp nhận dựa trên acceptance criteria và Definition of Done.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A new ERP finance module has passed all testing, but the accounting team has not been trained and month-end close is next week. What should the business analyst recommend?
option_A: Assess organizational readiness before confirming the date
option_B: Release it on schedule and train the users after month-end close
option_C: Release it now because all of the testing has been completed
option_D: Release now and email the users a written guide
explanation_en: Assess organizational readiness before deciding to release.
explanation_vi: Đánh giá mức sẵn sàng của tổ chức (readiness assessment) trước khi quyết định phát hành.
in_short_en: Assess organizational readiness before releasing a solution.
in_short_vi: Đánh giá mức sẵn sàng của tổ chức trước khi phát hành giải pháp.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which document details how requirements relate to each other and links them to project activities and deliverables?
option_A: Requirements traceability matrix
option_B: Requirements categorization list
option_C: Quality management plan
option_D: Requirements documentation
explanation_en: The requirements traceability matrix (RTM) links requirements to their sources, deliverables, and tests.
explanation_vi: Ma trận truy vết yêu cầu (requirements traceability matrix - RTM) nối yêu cầu với nguồn gốc, sản phẩm bàn giao và kiểm thử.
in_short_en: The requirements traceability matrix links requirements to their sources, deliverables, and tests.
in_short_vi: Ma trận truy vết yêu cầu (RTM) nối yêu cầu với nguồn gốc, sản phẩm bàn giao và kiểm thử.
source: Adapted from Abdullah Oguz, "Project Management, 2nd Edition" (Cleveland State University), Ch.4 Q6, CC BY-NC 4.0

question: During a tense status meeting, a stakeholder sharply criticizes the project. The project manager feels irritated but keeps her tone calm and asks a clarifying question instead of arguing back. Which emotional intelligence component is she MAINLY using?
option_A: Social skills
option_B: Empathy for others
option_C: Self-awareness
option_D: Self-management
explanation_en: Self-management (self-regulation): controlling your reaction even while feeling negative emotions.
explanation_vi: Tự quản lý cảm xúc (self-management/self-regulation): kiểm soát phản ứng dù đang có cảm xúc tiêu cực.
in_short_en: Controlling your own reaction despite strong emotions is self-management.
in_short_vi: Kiểm soát phản ứng của mình dù đang có cảm xúc mạnh là tự quản lý (self-management).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A usually talkative developer has gone quiet in meetings since a reorganization. The project manager notices this and privately asks how she is doing and whether anything is worrying her. Which emotional intelligence component does this show?
option_A: Self-awareness
option_B: Self-regulation
option_C: Conflict management
option_D: Empathy
explanation_en: Empathy, part of social awareness: recognizing and understanding other people's emotions.
explanation_vi: Thấu cảm (empathy), thuộc nhận thức xã hội (social awareness): nhận ra và hiểu cảm xúc của người khác.
in_short_en: Noticing and understanding a colleague's feelings is empathy (social awareness).
in_short_vi: Nhận ra và hiểu cảm xúc của đồng nghiệp là thấu cảm (empathy), thuộc nhận thức xã hội.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which action is BEST described as leadership rather than management?
option_A: Assigning work packages to people and confirming due dates
option_B: Inspiring the team around a shared vision for a new way of working
option_C: Reviewing timesheets and adjusting resource allocations
option_D: Tracking actual costs against the approved budget every week
explanation_en: Leadership focuses on people: vision, inspiration, motivation. Management focuses on processes and control.
explanation_vi: Lãnh đạo (leadership) tập trung vào con người: tầm nhìn, truyền cảm hứng, tạo động lực. Quản lý (management) tập trung vào quy trình, kiểm soát.
in_short_en: Inspiring people around a vision is leadership; controlling processes is management.
in_short_vi: Truyền cảm hứng quanh một tầm nhìn là lãnh đạo; kiểm soát quy trình là quản lý.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A retailer launches a project to replace paper stock counts with handheld scanners, so that stores can be restocked daily instead of weekly. How does this project relate to organizational change?
option_A: It is operations, because stock counts are already done every week
option_B: It creates no change until a program is formed around it
option_C: It moves the organization from its current state to a desired future state
option_D: It is a portfolio, because it affects many stores at once
explanation_en: A project is a vehicle for change: it moves the organization from its current state to a desired future state.
explanation_vi: Dự án là phương tiện tạo thay đổi (vehicle for change): đưa tổ chức từ trạng thái hiện tại sang trạng thái tương lai mong muốn.
in_short_en: Projects are vehicles for change, moving an organization from its current to a future state.
in_short_vi: Dự án là phương tiện tạo thay đổi, đưa tổ chức từ trạng thái hiện tại sang trạng thái tương lai.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: While proposals are still being evaluated, a vendor bidding on your project offers you free tickets to a major sports final. According to the PMI Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct, what should you do?
option_A: Decline the offer and disclose it as company policy requires
option_B: Accept, but score the vendor more strictly to stay neutral
option_C: Accept, since the tickets do not change the scoring criteria
option_D: Pass the tickets to a colleague who is not on the panel
explanation_en: Under the PMI Code of Ethics (the value of fairness), conflicts of interest must be avoided and disclosed.
explanation_vi: Theo Bộ quy tắc đạo đức của PMI (giá trị Fairness), phải tránh và công khai xung đột lợi ích.
in_short_en: Decline gifts that create a conflict of interest and disclose them.
in_short_vi: Từ chối quà tặng gây xung đột lợi ích và công khai việc đó.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project manager realizes that a cost estimate she gave the sponsor last week was based on a calculation error and is 20% too low. What should she do?
option_A: Ask the team to work overtime so that the estimate still holds
option_B: Cover the gap with the contingency reserve without reporting it
option_C: Wait to see whether the team can absorb the gap before raising it
option_D: Tell the sponsor promptly, correct the estimate, and explain the impact
explanation_en: The values of responsibility and honesty in the PMI Code of Ethics: own your mistakes and report them honestly and promptly.
explanation_vi: Giá trị Responsibility và Honesty trong Bộ quy tắc đạo đức PMI: nhận trách nhiệm về sai sót và báo cáo trung thực, kịp thời.
in_short_en: Own your mistakes and report them to the sponsor promptly.
in_short_vi: Nhận trách nhiệm về sai sót và báo cáo kịp thời cho sponsor.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which of the following is one of the eight project performance domains in the PMBOK Guide 7th Edition?
option_A: Uncertainty
option_B: Procurement
option_C: Integration
option_D: Closing
explanation_en: Uncertainty is one of the 8 performance domains in PMBOK 7: stakeholders, team, development approach and life cycle, planning, project work, delivery, measurement, uncertainty.
explanation_vi: Bất định (uncertainty) là một trong 8 lĩnh vực hiệu suất (performance domains) của PMBOK 7: stakeholders, team, development approach and life cycle, planning, project work, delivery, measurement, uncertainty.
in_short_en: Uncertainty is one of the eight PMBOK 7 performance domains.
in_short_vi: Uncertainty là một trong 8 miền hiệu suất của PMBOK 7.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A group of related projects managed in a coordinated way to obtain benefits not available from managing them individually is called a:
option_A: Portfolio
option_B: Operation
option_C: Program
option_D: Subproject
explanation_en: A program is a group of related projects (and activities) managed in a coordinated way to obtain benefits not available from managing them individually.
explanation_vi: Program là nhóm dự án (và hoạt động) liên quan, được quản lý phối hợp để đạt lợi ích mà quản lý riêng lẻ không đạt được.
in_short_en: Related projects managed together for added benefits form a program.
in_short_vi: Các dự án liên quan được quản lý chung để có thêm lợi ích tạo thành program.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which sequence lists the five Process Groups correctly?
option_A: Planning, Initiating, Executing, Closing, Monitoring and Controlling
option_B: Initiating, Executing, Planning, Closing, Monitoring and Controlling
option_C: Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring and Controlling, Closing
option_D: Planning, Executing, Initiating, Monitoring and Controlling, Closing
explanation_en: The order of the 5 Process Groups: Initiating → Planning → Executing → Monitoring & Controlling → Closing.
explanation_vi: Thứ tự 5 process group: Initiating → Planning → Executing → Monitoring & Controlling → Closing.
