in_short_en: The Process Groups are Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring and Controlling, and Closing.
in_short_vi: Các nhóm quy trình gồm Initiating, Planning, Executing, Monitoring and Controlling và Closing.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement best defines a project stakeholder?
option_A: Only the sponsor who funds the project and approves its charter
option_B: Only the people who work on the project team during execution
option_C: Anyone who may affect, be affected by, or feel affected by the project
option_D: Only the end users and customers who will receive and use the final product
explanation_en: A stakeholder is any individual, group, or organization that may affect, be affected by, or perceive itself to be affected by the project.
explanation_vi: Stakeholder là bất kỳ cá nhân, nhóm hoặc tổ chức nào có thể ảnh hưởng, bị ảnh hưởng, hoặc cho rằng mình bị ảnh hưởng bởi dự án.
in_short_en: A stakeholder is anyone who may affect, be affected by, or perceive themselves affected by the project.
in_short_vi: Stakeholder là bất kỳ ai có thể ảnh hưởng, bị ảnh hưởng hoặc cảm thấy bị ảnh hưởng bởi dự án.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does "progressive elaboration" mean?
option_A: Adding new scope to the project without any formal approval
option_B: Adding detail to a plan as more information becomes available
option_C: Skipping detailed planning so that work can start earlier
option_D: Assigning the same work to more people to finish it faster
explanation_en: Progressive elaboration means detailing the plan gradually as more information and more accurate estimates become available.
explanation_vi: Progressive elaboration là chi tiết hóa dần kế hoạch (plan) khi có thêm thông tin và ước tính (estimate) chính xác hơn.
in_short_en: Progressive elaboration adds detail to plans as more information becomes available.
in_short_vi: Làm rõ dần (progressive elaboration) là bổ sung chi tiết cho kế hoạch khi có thêm thông tin.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: On a power/interest grid, a stakeholder with high power and low interest should be:
option_A: Managed closely
option_B: Kept satisfied
option_C: Kept informed
option_D: Monitored with minimum effort
explanation_en: High power, low interest → Keep satisfied: meet their needs enough to keep them satisfied, without overly detailed updates.
explanation_vi: Power cao, interest thấp → Keep satisfied: đáp ứng đủ để họ hài lòng, nhưng không cần cập nhật quá chi tiết.
in_short_en: High power, low interest stakeholders should be kept satisfied.
in_short_vi: Stakeholder quyền lực cao, ít quan tâm cần được giữ hài lòng (keep satisfied).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the duration of a milestone?
option_A: One day
option_B: Zero
option_C: It depends on the activity
option_D: One week
explanation_en: A milestone is a significant point or event in time, with zero duration.
explanation_vi: Milestone là một thời điểm hoặc sự kiện quan trọng, có thời lượng (duration) bằng 0.
in_short_en: A milestone has zero duration.
in_short_vi: Milestone có thời lượng bằng 0.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the main risk of fast tracking?
option_A: Increased risk of rework
option_B: Increased cost from adding resources
option_C: A reduction in scope
option_D: Automatically lower quality standards
explanation_en: Fast tracking runs normally sequential activities in parallel, so the risk of rework increases.
explanation_vi: Fast tracking cho các hoạt động (activities) vốn tuần tự (sequential) chạy song song (in parallel), nên rủi ro (risk) phải làm lại (rework) tăng lên.
in_short_en: Fast tracking increases the risk of rework.
in_short_vi: Fast tracking làm tăng rủi ro phải làm lại.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A quality audit is performed to determine whether project activities comply with organizational policies, processes, and procedures. This activity belongs to:
option_A: Plan Quality Management
option_B: Control Quality
option_C: Manage Quality
option_D: Validate Scope
explanation_en: A quality audit belongs to Manage Quality (quality assurance): it checks whether project activities comply with organizational policies and processes.
explanation_vi: Quality audit thuộc Manage Quality (quality assurance): kiểm tra xem hoạt động dự án có tuân thủ (compliance) chính sách (policies) và quy trình của tổ chức không.
in_short_en: A quality audit checks process compliance and belongs to Manage Quality.
in_short_vi: Kiểm toán chất lượng kiểm tra việc tuân thủ quy trình và thuộc Manage Quality.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the maximum length of a Sprint in Scrum?
option_A: One month or less
option_B: Exactly two weeks
option_C: Six weeks
option_D: Three months
explanation_en: A Sprint is at most one month long (or shorter) and is kept fixed throughout development.
explanation_vi: Sprint có độ dài tối đa một tháng (hoặc ngắn hơn) và được giữ cố định trong suốt quá trình phát triển.
in_short_en: A Sprint lasts one month or less.
in_short_vi: Sprint dài một tháng hoặc ngắn hơn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A large, highly visible display of the team's progress, placed where everyone can see it, is called a(n):
option_A: Information radiator
option_B: Project status report
option_C: Stakeholder register
option_D: Gantt chart
explanation_en: An information radiator is a large, highly visible display (task board, burndown...) placed where everyone can see it, to share progress.
explanation_vi: Information radiator là bảng hiển thị lớn, dễ thấy (task board, burndown…) đặt ở nơi mọi người đều nhìn thấy để chia sẻ tiến độ (share progress).
in_short_en: A highly visible progress display is an information radiator.
in_short_vi: Màn hình hiển thị tiến độ ở nơi dễ thấy là information radiator.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which practice is MOST closely associated with Extreme Programming (XP)?
option_A: Pair programming
option_B: Program Increment (PI) planning
option_C: Work in progress (WIP) limits on a Kanban board
option_D: Earned value management
explanation_en: Pair programming is a signature XP practice, along with test-driven development (TDD), continuous integration, and refactoring.
explanation_vi: Lập trình theo cặp (pair programming) là thực hành đặc trưng của XP, cùng với test-driven development (TDD), tích hợp liên tục (continuous integration) và refactoring.
in_short_en: Pair programming is a signature XP practice.
in_short_vi: Lập trình cặp là thực hành đặc trưng của XP.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the purpose of the Sprint Review?
option_A: A team-only meeting to improve the team's processes
option_B: To inspect the Increment and adapt the backlog
option_C: For the CCB to review and approve change requests
option_D: To write and agree on the Definition of Done
explanation_en: The Sprint Review is the occasion to inspect the Increment with stakeholders, gather feedback, and adapt the Product Backlog.
explanation_vi: Sprint Review là dịp kiểm tra Increment cùng stakeholder, thu thập phản hồi (feedback) và điều chỉnh Product Backlog.
in_short_en: The Sprint Review inspects the Increment and adapts the Product Backlog.
in_short_vi: Sprint Review xem xét Increment và điều chỉnh Product Backlog.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Planning poker is a technique used for:
option_A: Prioritizing the product backlog
option_B: Assigning tasks to developers
option_C: Analyzing and ranking risks
option_D: Relative estimation by consensus
explanation_en: Planning poker is a consensus-based relative estimation technique: each person picks a card (often from a Fibonacci sequence), all reveal at the same time, and then discuss the differences.
explanation_vi: Planning poker là kỹ thuật ước lượng tương đối (relative estimation) dựa trên đồng thuận (consensus): mỗi người chọn lá bài (thường theo dãy Fibonacci), lật cùng lúc rồi thảo luận khác biệt.
in_short_en: Planning poker is consensus-based relative estimation.
in_short_vi: Planning poker là ước lượng tương đối dựa trên đồng thuận.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In MoSCoW prioritization, which category means "desirable but not necessary, included if time and resources permit"?
option_A: Must have
option_B: Should have
option_C: Could have
option_D: Won't have (this time)
explanation_en: Could have is the group that is desirable but not necessary, done only if time and resources allow.
explanation_vi: Could have là nhóm mong muốn có nhưng không cần thiết, chỉ làm nếu còn thời gian và nguồn lực (resources).
in_short_en: In MoSCoW, Could have means desirable but not necessary.
in_short_vi: Trong MoSCoW, Could have nghĩa là mong muốn có nhưng không cần thiết.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which role is accountable for the design, performance, and outcomes of a business process end to end, and decides how that process should change?
option_A: Process owner
option_B: Process manager
option_C: Product owner
option_D: Project sponsor
explanation_en: The process owner is accountable for the design, effectiveness, and results of an entire business process, and decides on changes to it.
explanation_vi: Chủ quy trình (process owner) chịu trách nhiệm giải trình về thiết kế, hiệu quả và kết quả của toàn bộ một quy trình kinh doanh, và quyết định thay đổi quy trình đó.
in_short_en: The process owner is accountable for a business process end to end.
in_short_vi: Process owner chịu trách nhiệm về một quy trình kinh doanh từ đầu đến cuối.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A requirement is best defined as:
option_A: A condition or capability needed to satisfy a business need
option_B: A task listed in the project schedule with its duration
option_C: A line item in the project budget with its estimated cost
option_D: An identified project risk recorded in the risk register
explanation_en: A requirement is a condition or capability that must be present in a product, service, or result to satisfy a business need.
explanation_vi: Requirement là điều kiện hoặc năng lực phải có trong sản phẩm, dịch vụ hoặc kết quả để đáp ứng một nhu cầu kinh doanh (business need).
in_short_en: A requirement is a condition or capability needed to satisfy a business need.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu là điều kiện hoặc năng lực cần có để đáp ứng một nhu cầu kinh doanh.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Business requirements describe:
option_A: Detailed technical specifications for each system component
option_B: User interface layouts for each screen of the solution
option_C: Test cases written for each feature of the solution
option_D: The high-level needs and objectives of the organization
explanation_en: Business requirements describe the organization's high-level needs and objectives, i.e., why the project is being done.
explanation_vi: Business requirements mô tả nhu cầu và mục tiêu (objectives) cấp cao của tổ chức, tức là lý do vì sao dự án được thực hiện.
in_short_en: Business requirements describe the organization's high-level needs and objectives.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu kinh doanh mô tả nhu cầu và mục tiêu cấp cao của tổ chức.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which elicitation technique involves watching users perform their work in their real environment?
option_A: Survey or questionnaire
option_B: Observation (job shadowing)
option_C: Competitive benchmarking
option_D: Analysis of existing documents
explanation_en: Observation (job shadowing) means watching users work in their real environment to understand the process and unspoken needs.
explanation_vi: Observation (job shadowing) là quan sát người dùng (user) làm việc trong môi trường thực tế để hiểu quy trình (process) và nhu cầu ngầm.
in_short_en: Watching users do their real work is observation (job shadowing).
in_short_vi: Quan sát người dùng làm việc thực tế là observation (job shadowing).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Questionnaires and surveys are MOST useful when:
option_A: Exploring a topic in depth with one subject matter expert
option_B: Capturing tacit knowledge by watching work being done
option_C: Gathering input quickly from a large, dispersed audience
option_D: Building consensus among conflicting stakeholders in one room
explanation_en: Questionnaires and surveys work best for gathering information quickly from a large, geographically dispersed group of respondents.
explanation_vi: Questionnaire và survey hiệu quả nhất khi cần thu thập thông tin nhanh từ số lượng lớn người trả lời, phân tán về địa lý.
in_short_en: Surveys gather input quickly from large, dispersed audiences.
in_short_vi: Khảo sát thu thập ý kiến nhanh từ nhóm đông và phân tán.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A gap analysis compares:
option_A: The current state with the desired future state
option_B: Prices quoted by two or more different vendors
option_C: The planned cost of work with its actual cost
option_D: Team members' current skills with their salaries
explanation_en: Gap analysis compares the current state with the desired future state to identify what must be done to close the gap.
explanation_vi: Gap analysis so sánh trạng thái hiện tại (current state) với trạng thái mong muốn (desired future state) để xác định những gì cần làm để thu hẹp khoảng cách.
in_short_en: A gap analysis compares the current state with the desired future state.
in_short_vi: Gap analysis so sánh trạng thái hiện tại với trạng thái tương lai mong muốn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which model shows the solution's boundary, the external entities, and the data flowing between them?
option_A: Fishbone diagram
option_B: Gantt chart
option_C: Context diagram
option_D: Burndown chart
explanation_en: A context diagram shows the solution boundary, external entities (users, other systems), and the data flows between them.
explanation_vi: Context diagram thể hiện ranh giới (boundary) giải pháp (solution), các thực thể bên ngoài (người dùng, hệ thống khác) và luồng dữ liệu (data flow) giữa chúng.
in_short_en: A context diagram shows the solution boundary and external data flows.
in_short_vi: Context diagram thể hiện ranh giới giải pháp và các luồng dữ liệu với bên ngoài.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: The features and functions that characterize a product describe the:
option_A: Product scope
option_B: Project scope
option_C: Scope baseline
option_D: Work package
explanation_en: The features and functions that characterize a product describe the product scope.
explanation_vi: Các tính năng (feature) và chức năng đặc trưng của sản phẩm mô tả product scope.
in_short_en: The features and functions of a product are its product scope.
in_short_vi: Tính năng và chức năng của sản phẩm là phạm vi sản phẩm (product scope).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Customers do not expect a feature, but they are delighted when it is present. In the Kano model, this feature is a(n):
option_A: Excitement (delighter) feature
option_B: Basic (must-be) feature
option_C: Performance (one-dimensional) feature
option_D: Indifferent (no-impact) feature
explanation_en: In the Kano model, a feature customers do not expect but love when present is an excitement feature (delighter).
explanation_vi: Theo mô hình Kano, tính năng (feature) khách hàng (customer) không kỳ vọng nhưng rất thích khi có là excitement (delighter).
in_short_en: Unexpected features that delight customers are Kano excitement features.
in_short_vi: Tính năng bất ngờ làm khách hàng thích thú là tính năng excitement trong mô hình Kano.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Transition requirements describe:
option_A: Security controls that must protect the solution once it goes live
option_B: Temporary needs, like data conversion, to reach the future state
option_C: The final user interface design of the completed solution
option_D: Legal contract terms agreed with the solution's vendor
explanation_en: Transition requirements describe the temporary capabilities needed to move from the current state to the future state, such as data conversion and user training.
explanation_vi: Transition requirements mô tả các năng lực tạm thời (temporary) cần có để chuyển từ trạng thái hiện tại (current state) sang trạng thái tương lai, như chuyển đổi dữ liệu (data conversion) và đào tạo (training) người dùng (user).
in_short_en: Transition requirements are temporary needs for moving to the future state.
in_short_vi: Yêu cầu chuyển đổi là nhu cầu tạm thời để chuyển sang trạng thái tương lai.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Acceptance criteria are:
option_A: The entries in the WBS dictionary for each work package
option_B: Lessons learned recorded from similar past projects
option_C: Entries in the issue log that must be resolved
option_D: Conditions a deliverable must meet to be accepted
explanation_en: Acceptance criteria are the conditions that must be met before a deliverable is accepted.
explanation_vi: Acceptance criteria là các điều kiện phải được đáp ứng trước khi deliverable được chấp nhận.
in_short_en: Acceptance criteria are conditions a deliverable must meet to be accepted.
in_short_vi: Tiêu chí chấp nhận là các điều kiện deliverable phải đạt để được chấp nhận.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What BEST defines a portfolio?
option_A: A temporary effort undertaken to deliver a unique result
option_B: Projects, programs, and operations grouped to meet strategic objectives
option_C: The full series of phases that a project passes through from start to finish
option_D: A set of related projects coordinated to gain combined benefits
explanation_en: Portfolio: projects, programs, and operations managed together to meet strategic objectives.
explanation_vi: Danh mục (portfolio): dự án, chương trình và vận hành được quản lý chung vì mục tiêu chiến lược.
in_short_en: A portfolio groups projects, programs, and operations to meet strategic objectives.
in_short_vi: Portfolio gom dự án, chương trình và vận hành để đạt mục tiêu chiến lược.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which pair of characteristics describes operations rather than projects?
option_A: Funded once and closed at the end
option_B: Temporary and unique
option_C: Ongoing and repetitive
option_D: Time-bound and progressively elaborated
explanation_en: Operations are ongoing and repetitive; a project is temporary and creates a unique result.
explanation_vi: Vận hành (operations) diễn ra liên tục và lặp lại; dự án là tạm thời và tạo kết quả duy nhất.
in_short_en: Operations are ongoing and repetitive; projects are temporary and unique.
in_short_vi: Vận hành liên tục và lặp lại; dự án tạm thời và duy nhất.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In which Process Group is the project charter developed and approved?
option_A: Initiating
option_B: Planning
option_C: Executing
option_D: Closing
explanation_en: The project charter is developed and approved in the Initiating Process Group.
explanation_vi: Project charter được xây dựng và phê duyệt trong nhóm quy trình Initiating.
in_short_en: The charter is developed and approved in Initiating.
in_short_vi: Charter được xây dựng và phê duyệt trong nhóm Initiating.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement about Process Groups and project phases is correct?
option_A: Process Groups are performed once per project
option_B: Phases exist only in adaptive projects
option_C: Each phase is the same as one Process Group
option_D: Process Groups can occur within every phase
explanation_en: Process Groups are logical groupings of processes that can repeat within each phase; they are not phases.
explanation_vi: Process Groups là nhóm logic các quy trình, có thể lặp lại trong mỗi pha; chúng không phải là pha.
in_short_en: Process Groups can repeat within each phase; they are not phases.
in_short_vi: Các nhóm quy trình có thể lặp lại trong mỗi pha; chúng không phải là pha.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In a typical predictive life cycle, how do cost and staffing levels change over time?
option_A: Low until closing, then peak for the final handover
option_B: Low at first, peak during the work, then drop near the end
option_C: Constant from start to finish if the plan is followed
option_D: High at first, then decline steadily all the way until closing
explanation_en: Cost and staffing start low, peak during the main work, and then drop quickly near the end.
explanation_vi: Chi phí và nhân lực thấp lúc đầu, đạt đỉnh khi thực hiện công việc chính, rồi giảm nhanh khi kết thúc.
in_short_en: Cost and staffing start low, peak during the work, and drop near the end.
in_short_vi: Chi phí và nhân lực thấp lúc đầu, đạt đỉnh khi làm việc chính và giảm khi gần kết thúc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the main purpose of the Develop Project Management Plan process?
option_A: To record and resolve problems as they arise during project work
option_B: To estimate how long each scheduled activity will take
option_C: To evaluate change requests and decide on each one
option_D: To integrate all subsidiary plans and baselines into one plan
explanation_en: Develop Project Management Plan creates one integrated plan that includes the subsidiary plans and baselines.
explanation_vi: Develop Project Management Plan tạo một kế hoạch tích hợp gồm các kế hoạch con và baseline.
in_short_en: Develop Project Management Plan integrates all subsidiary plans and baselines.
in_short_vi: Develop Project Management Plan tích hợp mọi kế hoạch con và baseline.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is a risk threshold?
option_A: The variation around an objective that stakeholders accept
option_B: The total contingency reserve set aside for known risks
option_C: The date by which all project risks must be identified
option_D: The number of risks the risk register is allowed to hold
explanation_en: A risk threshold is the amount of variation around an objective that stakeholders will accept, derived from risk appetite.
explanation_vi: Ngưỡng rủi ro (risk threshold): mức sai lệch quanh một mục tiêu mà stakeholder chấp nhận, xuất phát từ khẩu vị rủi ro (risk appetite).
in_short_en: A risk threshold is the acceptable variation around an objective.
in_short_vi: Ngưỡng rủi ro là mức sai lệch chấp nhận được quanh một mục tiêu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In qualitative risk analysis, how is a risk's priority score commonly calculated?
option_A: Impact in dollars divided by the total budget
option_B: Probability rating added to impact rating
option_C: Expected monetary value multiplied by duration
option_D: Probability rating multiplied by impact rating
explanation_en: Risk priority score = probability × impact (using the scales in the risk management plan).
explanation_vi: Điểm ưu tiên rủi ro = xác suất × tác động (theo thang điểm trong risk management plan).
in_short_en: Risk score = probability × impact.
in_short_vi: Điểm rủi ro = xác suất × tác động.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does a SWOT analysis examine when used to identify risks?
option_A: The root causes of one problem, using repeated "why" questions
option_B: Strengths and weaknesses inside, opportunities and threats outside
option_C: Expert opinions gathered anonymously over several rounds of review
option_D: Assumptions and constraints recorded in the project plan
explanation_en: SWOT examines internal strengths and weaknesses and external opportunities and threats to find risks.
explanation_vi: SWOT xem xét điểm mạnh, điểm yếu bên trong và cơ hội, thách thức bên ngoài để tìm rủi ro.
in_short_en: SWOT examines internal strengths/weaknesses and external opportunities/threats.
in_short_vi: SWOT xét điểm mạnh, điểm yếu bên trong và cơ hội, thách thức bên ngoài.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which type of PMO exercises the HIGHEST degree of control by directly managing projects?
option_A: Directive
option_B: Controlling
option_C: Supportive
option_D: Enterprise
explanation_en: A directive PMO manages projects directly and has the highest degree of control.
explanation_vi: PMO chỉ đạo (directive) trực tiếp quản lý dự án, mức kiểm soát cao nhất.
in_short_en: A directive PMO manages projects directly and has the highest control.
in_short_vi: PMO chỉ đạo (directive) trực tiếp quản lý dự án và có mức kiểm soát cao nhất.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In a RACI chart, what does "C" stand for?
option_A: Controlled: someone who signs off on the final result
option_B: Consulted: someone whose input is sought before the work is done
option_C: Committed: someone who funds the work being done
option_D: Coordinated: someone who schedules the work for the others involved
explanation_en: C = Consulted: someone whose opinion is sought before or during the work.
explanation_vi: C = Consulted: người được hỏi ý kiến trước hoặc trong khi làm.
in_short_en: C in RACI means Consulted.
in_short_vi: Chữ C trong RACI là Consulted.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In which organizational structure does the project manager usually have LOW authority and often work part-time on the project?
option_A: Projectized
option_B: Balanced matrix
option_C: Strong matrix
option_D: Functional
explanation_en: In a functional organization, the PM has little authority and often works part-time.
explanation_vi: Trong tổ chức chức năng (functional), PM có ít quyền và thường làm bán thời gian.
in_short_en: PMs have low authority and often work part-time in functional organizations.
in_short_vi: Trong tổ chức chức năng, PM có ít quyền và thường làm bán thời gian.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which set of activities belongs to Develop Team?
option_A: Tracking resource use against the plan
option_B: Training, team building, and recognition
option_C: Estimating resource types and quantities
option_D: Pre-assignment, negotiation, and acquisition
explanation_en: Develop Team: training, team building, recognition, and rewards.
explanation_vi: Phát triển đội (Develop Team): đào tạo, team building, ghi nhận và khen thưởng.
in_short_en: Training, team building, and recognition develop the team.
in_short_vi: Đào tạo, team building và ghi nhận giúp phát triển đội.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In Tuckman's model of team development, which stage comes right after storming?
option_A: Norming
option_B: Forming
option_C: Performing
option_D: Adjourning
explanation_en: The Tuckman sequence: forming, storming, norming, performing, adjourning.
explanation_vi: Thứ tự Tuckman: forming, storming, norming, performing, adjourning.
in_short_en: Norming follows storming.
in_short_vi: Norming đến sau storming.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In the basic communication model, what is "noise"?
option_A: The medium or channel chosen to carry the message
option_B: Anything that disrupts sending or understanding a message
option_C: The feedback that the receiver sends back to the original sender
option_D: The sender turning thoughts into words or symbols
explanation_en: Noise: anything that interferes with sending or understanding a message, such as language, culture, or distance.
explanation_vi: Nhiễu (noise): bất cứ điều gì cản trở việc truyền hoặc hiểu thông điệp, như ngôn ngữ, văn hóa, khoảng cách.
in_short_en: Noise is anything that interferes with sending or understanding a message.
in_short_vi: Nhiễu (noise) là bất cứ điều gì cản trở việc truyền hoặc hiểu thông điệp.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which is an example of pull communication?
option_A: A weekly meeting with the project steering committee and sponsor
option_B: A phone call to a supplier to confirm a delivery
option_C: A status email sent to all stakeholders every Friday
option_D: A project wiki that stakeholders read whenever they need to
explanation_en: Pull communication: recipients access the information themselves when they need it, such as a wiki or document repository.
explanation_vi: Giao tiếp kéo (pull): người nhận tự truy cập thông tin khi cần, như wiki, kho tài liệu.
in_short_en: Information that recipients access on their own is pull communication.
in_short_vi: Thông tin người nhận tự truy cập là giao tiếp kéo (pull).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which behavior is part of active listening?
option_A: Paraphrasing what was said to confirm understanding
option_B: Focusing only on the words, not on tone or body language
option_C: Interrupting to correct factual errors right away
option_D: Preparing your reply while the other person is speaking
explanation_en: Active listening: focusing, paraphrasing, and asking clarifying questions to understand correctly.
explanation_vi: Lắng nghe chủ động: tập trung, tóm tắt lại, hỏi làm rõ để hiểu đúng.
in_short_en: Paraphrasing to confirm understanding is part of active listening.
in_short_vi: Diễn đạt lại để xác nhận đã hiểu đúng là một phần của lắng nghe chủ động.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement about the project charter is correct?
option_A: It is approved by the project manager without a sponsor
option_B: It is created only after the project management plan has been completed
option_C: It contains the detailed schedule and cost baselines
option_D: It formally authorizes the project and the PM's use of resources
explanation_en: The project charter formally authorizes the project and gives the PM authority to use organizational resources.
explanation_vi: Project charter chính thức cho phép dự án và trao quyền cho PM dùng nguồn lực của tổ chức.
in_short_en: The charter authorizes the project and the PM.
in_short_vi: Charter cho phép dự án và trao quyền cho PM.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the purpose of the Monitor Risks process?
option_A: Rate the probability and impact of each identified risk
option_B: Track responses, find new risks, and check the risk process works
option_C: Select response strategies for the prioritized risks
option_D: Decide how risk management activities will be organized and performed
explanation_en: Monitor Risks: tracking how responses are implemented, identifying new risks, and evaluating the effectiveness of the risk process.
explanation_vi: Giám sát rủi ro (Monitor Risks): theo dõi việc thực hiện ứng phó, phát hiện rủi ro mới, đánh giá hiệu quả quy trình rủi ro.
in_short_en: Monitor Risks tracks responses, identifies new risks, and evaluates the risk process.
in_short_vi: Monitor Risks theo dõi phương án ứng phó, phát hiện rủi ro mới và đánh giá quy trình rủi ro.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the main difference between the "exploit" and "enhance" responses to an opportunity?
option_A: Exploit involves a third party; enhance keeps the opportunity in-house
option_B: Exploit raises its probability or impact; enhance makes the opportunity certain
option_C: Exploit is used for threats; enhance is used for opportunities
option_D: Exploit makes the opportunity certain; enhance raises its probability or impact
explanation_en: Exploit: make sure the opportunity happens. Enhance: increase its probability or impact. Share: allocate it to a capable third party.
explanation_vi: Exploit: đảm bảo cơ hội chắc chắn xảy ra. Enhance: tăng xác suất hoặc tác động. Share: chia cho bên thứ ba có năng lực.
in_short_en: Exploit makes an opportunity certain; enhance increases its probability or impact.
in_short_vi: Exploit làm cơ hội chắc chắn xảy ra; enhance tăng xác suất hoặc tác động của nó.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: When are source selection criteria for vendors usually defined?
option_A: During Conduct Procurements, after the bids have arrived
option_B: During Plan Procurement Management, before bids are requested
option_C: During Control Procurements, while the contract is underway
option_D: During project closing, when contracts are completed
explanation_en: Vendor selection criteria are defined during procurement planning, before bids are requested.
explanation_vi: Tiêu chí chọn nhà cung cấp được xác định khi lập kế hoạch mua sắm, trước khi mời thầu.
in_short_en: Source selection criteria are set in Plan Procurement Management.
in_short_vi: Tiêu chí chọn nhà cung cấp được đặt trong Plan Procurement Management.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A new team member asks what she will find in the project's communications management plan. Which item does it typically contain?
option_A: The criteria for team recognition and rewards
option_B: The quality metrics for each deliverable
option_C: The escalation process for unresolved concerns
option_D: The cost baseline and the funding limits
explanation_en: The communications management plan covers who needs what information, when, through which channel, and the escalation process.
explanation_vi: Communications management plan gồm: ai cần thông tin gì, khi nào, kênh nào, và quy trình escalate.
in_short_en: Escalation paths belong in the communications management plan.
in_short_vi: Quy trình escalate thuộc kế hoạch quản lý truyền thông.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is an affinity diagram used for?
option_A: Showing whether two variables are related to each other
option_B: Grouping large numbers of ideas into related themes
option_C: Ranking causes by how often they occur
option_D: Checking whether a process is stable over time
explanation_en: An affinity diagram groups many ideas into clusters by theme.
explanation_vi: Affinity diagram nhóm nhiều ý tưởng thành các cụm theo chủ đề.
in_short_en: An affinity diagram groups ideas into themes.
in_short_vi: Affinity diagram nhóm các ý tưởng thành chủ đề.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does a scatter diagram show?
option_A: Whether a process stays within its limits
option_B: Whether two variables are related
option_C: How often each type of defect occurs
option_D: The steps of a process in sequence
explanation_en: A scatter diagram shows the correlation between two variables.
explanation_vi: Biểu đồ phân tán (scatter diagram) cho thấy mối tương quan giữa hai biến.
in_short_en: A scatter diagram shows whether two variables are related.
in_short_vi: Scatter diagram cho thấy hai biến có liên quan với nhau hay không.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is a discretionary dependency?
option_A: A sequence chosen from best practice that the work does not strictly require
option_B: A sequence required by law, a contract, or the physical nature of the work
option_C: A delay deliberately inserted between two scheduled activities
option_D: A relationship between project work and work outside the project
explanation_en: A discretionary dependency is an order the team chooses based on experience or best practice.
explanation_vi: Phụ thuộc tùy chọn (discretionary): thứ tự do đội chọn dựa trên kinh nghiệm hay thực hành tốt.
in_short_en: A discretionary dependency is a preferred sequence, not a required one.
in_short_vi: Phụ thuộc tùy chọn là thứ tự được ưa chuộng, không phải bắt buộc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is an external dependency?
option_A: A link between project activities and work outside the project
option_B: A relationship between two teams within the same project
option_C: A sequence that the team prefers based on its past experience
option_D: A relationship that the nature of the work makes unavoidable
explanation_en: An external dependency links project activities with non-project activities, such as a supplier or a permitting authority.
explanation_vi: Phụ thuộc bên ngoài (external): giữa hoạt động dự án và hoạt động ngoài dự án, như nhà cung cấp hay cơ quan cấp phép.
in_short_en: An external dependency links project work to work outside the project.
in_short_vi: Phụ thuộc bên ngoài nối công việc dự án với công việc ngoài dự án.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is the main trade-off of analogous estimating?
option_A: It needs a reliable unit rate from past data
option_B: It is quick and cheap, but usually less accurate
option_C: It needs three estimates for every activity
option_D: It is very accurate, but needs a detailed WBS
explanation_en: Analogous estimating is quick and cheap, based on similar projects, but less accurate.
explanation_vi: Ước lượng tương tự (analogous): nhanh, rẻ, dựa trên dự án tương tự, nhưng kém chính xác hơn.
in_short_en: Analogous estimating is quick and cheap but less accurate.
in_short_vi: Ước lượng tương tự nhanh và rẻ nhưng kém chính xác hơn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does the WBS dictionary provide?
option_A: The sequence and dependencies of all of the project's activities
option_B: Each WBS component's description, owner, and acceptance criteria
option_C: The links between each requirement and its source and test
option_D: The list of stakeholders with their interests and influence
explanation_en: The WBS dictionary describes each WBS component in detail: scope, owner, acceptance criteria, account code.
explanation_vi: WBS dictionary mô tả chi tiết từng thành phần WBS: phạm vi, người phụ trách, tiêu chí chấp nhận, mã tài khoản.
in_short_en: The WBS dictionary details each WBS component.
in_short_vi: WBS dictionary mô tả chi tiết từng thành phần của WBS.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does a finish-to-finish (FF) relationship mean?
option_A: The successor cannot start until the predecessor has finished
option_B: The successor cannot finish until the predecessor has finished
option_C: The successor cannot finish until the predecessor has started
option_D: The successor cannot start until the predecessor has started
explanation_en: FF: the successor can finish only when the predecessor has finished.
explanation_vi: FF: hoạt động sau chỉ kết thúc được khi hoạt động trước đã kết thúc.
in_short_en: FF means the successor cannot finish until the predecessor finishes.
in_short_vi: FF nghĩa là hoạt động sau không thể kết thúc cho đến khi hoạt động trước kết thúc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement correctly contrasts Validate Scope and Control Quality?
option_A: Both are carried out only by the customer at the end
option_B: Validate Scope is normally performed before Control Quality
option_C: Validate Scope is about acceptance; Control Quality is about correctness
option_D: Validate Scope is about correctness; Control Quality is about acceptance
explanation_en: Control Quality checks that deliverables meet quality requirements; Validate Scope is the customer's formal acceptance.
explanation_vi: Control Quality kiểm tra deliverable đúng yêu cầu chất lượng; Validate Scope là khách hàng chính thức chấp nhận.
in_short_en: Validate Scope is acceptance; Control Quality is correctness.
in_short_vi: Validate Scope là sự chấp nhận; Control Quality là sự đúng đắn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: In earned value management, what does the estimate to complete (ETC) represent?
option_A: The gap between the budget and the forecast
option_B: The expected cost of the remaining work
option_C: The total expected cost of the project
option_D: The budgeted value of the work done so far
explanation_en: ETC: the expected cost to complete the remaining work.
explanation_vi: ETC: chi phí dự kiến để hoàn thành phần công việc còn lại.
in_short_en: ETC is the expected cost of the remaining work.
in_short_vi: ETC là chi phí dự kiến cho phần công việc còn lại.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does planned value (PV) measure?
option_A: The authorized budget for the work scheduled to date
option_B: The forecast cost of finishing the whole remaining project
option_C: The actual cost of the work performed to date
option_D: The budgeted value of the work actually completed
explanation_en: PV: the authorized budget for the work scheduled to be completed by the measurement date.
explanation_vi: PV: ngân sách được duyệt cho công việc dự kiến hoàn thành tới thời điểm đo.
in_short_en: PV is the authorized budget for work scheduled to date.
in_short_vi: PV là ngân sách được duyệt cho công việc dự kiến làm tới thời điểm đo.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What is a change log?
option_A: A list of lessons learned for future projects
option_B: A list of risks and their planned responses
option_C: A record of problems and issues that still need to be resolved
option_D: A record of change requests and their current status
explanation_en: The change log records change requests and their status (approved, rejected, deferred).
explanation_vi: Change log ghi lại các yêu cầu thay đổi và trạng thái (đã duyệt, từ chối, hoãn).
in_short_en: The change log records change requests and their status.
in_short_vi: Change log ghi các yêu cầu thay đổi và trạng thái của chúng.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which three components make up the scope baseline?
option_A: Approved scope statement, WBS, and WBS dictionary
option_B: Charter, scope statement, and requirements
option_C: WBS, schedule baseline, and cost baseline
option_D: The requirements documentation, the RTM, and the WBS
explanation_en: Scope baseline = approved scope statement + WBS + WBS dictionary.
explanation_vi: Scope baseline = scope statement + WBS + WBS dictionary đã được duyệt.
in_short_en: Scope baseline = scope statement, WBS, and WBS dictionary.
in_short_vi: Scope baseline = scope statement, WBS và WBS dictionary.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which reserve is EXCLUDED from the cost baseline but included in the project budget?
option_A: Management reserve
option_B: Work package estimates
option_C: Activity cost estimates
option_D: Contingency reserve
explanation_en: Management reserve is outside the cost baseline but part of the total project budget.
explanation_vi: Management reserve nằm ngoài cost baseline, nhưng thuộc tổng ngân sách dự án.
in_short_en: Management reserve is outside the cost baseline but inside the project budget.
in_short_vi: Management reserve nằm ngoài cost baseline nhưng thuộc ngân sách dự án.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does a schedule performance index (SPI) of 0.8 indicate?
option_A: The project is 20% ahead of its schedule
option_B: Work is progressing at 80% of the planned rate
option_C: The project earns 80 cents of value per dollar spent
option_D: The project has spent 80% of its total budget
explanation_en: SPI = EV/PV; 0.8 means only 80% of the planned work has been achieved, i.e., behind schedule.
explanation_vi: SPI = EV/PV; 0,8 nghĩa là chỉ đạt 80% khối lượng theo kế hoạch, tức chậm tiến độ.
in_short_en: SPI 0.8 means work is progressing at 80% of the planned rate.
in_short_vi: SPI 0,8 nghĩa là công việc tiến triển ở mức 80% so với kế hoạch.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Under a time and materials (T&M) contract, how is the seller paid?
option_A: Actual costs plus an extra fee tied to performance
option_B: A fixed total price agreed before any of the work starts
option_C: A fixed price adjusted each year for inflation
option_D: At agreed rates for the time and materials actually used
explanation_en: T&M pays agreed unit rates for the time and materials actually used.
explanation_vi: T&M trả theo đơn giá thỏa thuận cho thời gian và vật tư thực tế sử dụng.
in_short_en: T&M pays agreed rates for the time and materials actually used.
in_short_vi: T&M trả theo đơn giá thỏa thuận cho thời gian và vật tư thực tế sử dụng.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A negative schedule variance (SV) means that:
option_A: the critical path has become shorter
option_B: more money has been spent on the work than was planned
option_C: less work has been completed than planned
option_D: the project is likely to finish early
explanation_en: SV = EV - PV; negative means less work was done than planned.
explanation_vi: SV = EV - PV; âm nghĩa là làm được ít hơn kế hoạch.
in_short_en: Negative SV means less work is done than planned.
in_short_vi: SV âm nghĩa là làm được ít hơn kế hoạch.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which feature distinguishes a fixed price incentive fee (FPIF) contract?
option_A: Reimbursement of all allowable costs plus a fixed fee
option_B: One fixed price with no incentives at all
option_C: Payment at hourly rates for the time spent
option_D: A target price with incentives and a ceiling price
explanation_en: FPIF has a target price, an incentive mechanism, and a ceiling price.
explanation_vi: FPIF có giá mục tiêu, cơ chế khuyến khích và giá trần (ceiling price).
in_short_en: FPIF has a target price, incentives, and a ceiling price.
in_short_vi: FPIF có giá mục tiêu, cơ chế khuyến khích và giá trần.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which practice is typical of stakeholder engagement on agile projects?
option_A: Monthly written status reports as the main channel
option_B: Engagement mainly at project initiation and closing
option_C: Frequent reviews of working increments with stakeholders
option_D: Formal sign-off on a full requirements document up front
explanation_en: Agile engages stakeholders through transparency and frequent feedback on a working product.
explanation_vi: Agile thu hút stakeholder qua minh bạch và phản hồi thường xuyên trên sản phẩm chạy được.
in_short_en: Agile engages stakeholders through frequent reviews of working increments.
in_short_vi: Agile thu hút stakeholder qua việc thường xuyên xem xét các increment chạy được.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: How do agile teams usually plan their schedule?
option_A: In short, fixed-length iterations, detailing only the near term
option_B: With long cycles and reviews only at major milestones
option_C: With critical path analysis of every task at the start
option_D: With one detailed schedule baseline that covers the whole project
explanation_en: Agile plans in short iterations, in detail for the near term, and forecasts the long term with velocity.
explanation_vi: Agile lập kế hoạch theo iteration ngắn, chi tiết cho ngắn hạn, dự báo dài hạn bằng velocity.
in_short_en: Agile teams plan in short iterations and detail only the near term.
in_short_vi: Đội agile lập kế hoạch theo iteration ngắn và chỉ chi tiết cho ngắn hạn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which information is typically recorded in a stakeholder register?
option_A: Identification, assessment, and classification details
option_B: Activity durations, dependencies, and their float values
option_C: Risks, their owners, and their planned responses
option_D: Change requests and their approval status by date
explanation_en: The stakeholder register records identification, assessment (needs, influence), and classification information about stakeholders.
explanation_vi: Stakeholder register ghi thông tin nhận diện, đánh giá (nhu cầu, ảnh hưởng) và phân loại stakeholder.
in_short_en: The stakeholder register holds identification, assessment, and classification details.
in_short_vi: Stakeholder register chứa thông tin nhận diện, đánh giá và phân loại stakeholder.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: When is prototyping MOST useful in requirements elicitation?
option_A: When requirements are already fully known and documented
option_B: When the goal is to review the terms of the existing vendor contracts
option_C: When feedback is needed quickly from thousands of users
option_D: When stakeholders struggle to describe needs without seeing them
explanation_en: Prototypes are useful when users struggle to express requirements in words; a concrete model helps them give feedback.
explanation_vi: Prototype hữu ích khi người dùng khó diễn đạt yêu cầu bằng lời; mô hình cụ thể giúp họ phản hồi.
in_short_en: Prototype when stakeholders struggle to describe needs in words.
in_short_vi: Dùng prototype khi stakeholder khó mô tả nhu cầu bằng lời.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project has a BAC of $500,000, an EV of $200,000, and an AC of $250,000. If current cost performance continues, what is the estimate to complete (ETC)?
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project has a BAC of $80,000, an EV of $30,000, and an AC of $36,000. The overrun came from a one-time event that will not happen again. What is the estimate to complete (ETC)?
explanation_en: Atypical variance: the remaining work will cost exactly its budget, so ETC = BAC - EV = $50,000.
explanation_vi: Chênh lệch bất thường (atypical): phần còn lại tốn đúng ngân sách, ETC = BAC - EV = 50.000.
in_short_en: For a one-time variance, ETC = BAC - EV = $50,000.
in_short_vi: Với chênh lệch chỉ xảy ra một lần, ETC = BAC - EV = 50.000 USD.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: The team re-estimates all remaining work bottom-up at $90,000. Actual cost to date is $150,000, and the BAC is $220,000. What are the ETC and the EAC?
explanation_en: When the remaining work is re-estimated, ETC = the new estimate = $90,000; EAC = AC + ETC = $240,000.
explanation_vi: Khi ước lượng lại phần còn lại, ETC = ước lượng mới = 90.000; EAC = AC + ETC = 240.000.
in_short_en: With a new bottom-up ETC of $90,000, EAC = AC + ETC = $240,000.
in_short_vi: Với ETC ước lượng lại từ dưới lên là 90.000 USD, EAC = AC + ETC = 240.000 USD.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Using probability × impact, which risk has the HIGHEST priority? Risk A: 0.5 × 0.4. Risk B: 0.9 × 0.2. Risk C: 0.3 × 0.8. Risk D: 0.7 × 0.1.
option_A: Risk A
option_B: Risk B
option_C: Risk C
option_D: Risk D
explanation_en: A = 0.20; B = 0.18; C = 0.24; D = 0.07. Risk C is the highest.
in_short_en: Compute probability × impact for each risk; Risk C scores highest at 0.24.
in_short_vi: Tính xác suất × tác động cho từng rủi ro; Risk C cao nhất với 0,24.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project has a threat with a 40% probability and an impact of -$30,000, and an opportunity with a 25% probability and an impact of +$16,000. What is the combined expected monetary value (EMV)?
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A risk management plan rates priority as high for scores of 0.40 or more, medium for 0.10 to 0.39, and low below 0.10. A risk has a probability of 0.7 and an impact of 0.8. What is its score and priority?
option_A: 0.56, medium priority
option_B: 1.50, high priority
option_C: 0.15, medium priority
option_D: 0.56, high priority
explanation_en: 0.7 × 0.8 = 0.56 ≥ 0.40, so it is high priority.
explanation_vi: 0,7 × 0,8 = 0,56 ≥ 0,40 nên là ưu tiên cao.
in_short_en: 0.7 × 0.8 = 0.56, which is above 0.40, so high priority.
in_short_vi: 0,7 × 0,8 = 0,56, vượt ngưỡng 0,40 nên là ưu tiên cao.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network: A (4 days) starts the project. B (6 days) and C (3 days) both follow A. D (5 days) follows C. E (2 days) follows both B and D.
question: What is the project's total duration?
option_A: 12 days
option_B: 14 days
option_C: 16 days
option_D: 20 days
explanation_en: Path A-B-E = 4+6+2 = 12; path A-C-D-E = 4+3+5+2 = 14. The longest, critical path = 14 days.
explanation_vi: Đường A-B-E = 4+6+2 = 12; đường A-C-D-E = 4+3+5+2 = 14. Đường găng dài nhất = 14 ngày.
in_short_en: The critical path A-C-D-E is 14 days, so the project takes 14 days.
in_short_vi: Đường găng A-C-D-E dài 14 ngày, nên dự án mất 14 ngày.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network: A (4 days) starts the project. B (6 days) and C (3 days) both follow A. D (5 days) follows C. E (2 days) follows both B and D.
question: What is the total float of activity B?
option_A: 0 days
option_B: 1 day
option_C: 2 days
option_D: 4 days
explanation_en: The path through B is 12 days and the critical path is 14 days, so B's float = 2 days.
explanation_vi: Đường qua B dài 12 ngày, đường găng 14 ngày, nên float của B = 2 ngày.
in_short_en: B's path is 12 days versus a 14-day critical path, so B has 2 days of float.
in_short_vi: Đường qua B dài 12 ngày so với đường găng 14 ngày, nên B có 2 ngày float.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network: A (4 days) starts the project. B (6 days) and C (3 days) both follow A. D (5 days) follows C. E (2 days) follows both B and D.
question: Activity C is delayed by 3 days. What is the effect on the project?
option_A: The project is unaffected, because B has float
option_B: The project finishes 3 days late, at 17 days
option_C: The critical path switches to A-B-E
option_D: The project finishes 1 day late, at 15 days
explanation_en: C is on the critical path; A-C-D-E becomes 17 days, so the project is 3 days late.
explanation_vi: C nằm trên đường găng; A-C-D-E thành 17 ngày, dự án trễ 3 ngày.
in_short_en: C is critical, so a 3-day delay pushes the finish to 17 days.
in_short_vi: C nằm trên đường găng nên trễ 3 ngày đẩy ngày kết thúc lên 17 ngày.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project team grows from 6 people to 9 people. How many communication channels are added?
explanation_en: Channels = n(n−1)/2. 6 people: 15 channels; 9 people: 36 channels; 21 channels added.
explanation_vi: Số kênh = n(n−1)/2. 6 người: 15 kênh; 9 người: 36 kênh; tăng thêm 21 kênh.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project team has 12 people, including the project manager. How many communication channels are there?
in_short_en: 12 × 11 / 2 = 66 channels.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network (the project starts at day 0): A (3 days) starts the project. B (4 days) and C (6 days) both follow A. D (2 days) follows both B and C.
question: Using a forward pass, what is the early start (ES) of activity D?
option_A: Day 3
option_B: Day 7
option_C: Day 9
option_D: Day 11
explanation_en: EF(A) = 3; EF(B) = 7; EF(C) = 9. D needs both B and C finished, so ES(D) = max(7, 9) = 9.
explanation_vi: EF(A) = 3; EF(B) = 7; EF(C) = 9. D cần cả B và C xong, nên ES(D) = max(7, 9) = 9.
in_short_en: When an activity has several predecessors, its ES is the largest predecessor EF: 9.
in_short_vi: Khi một hoạt động có nhiều hoạt động trước, ES của nó là EF lớn nhất: 9.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network (the project starts at day 0): A (3 days) starts the project. B (4 days) and C (6 days) both follow A. D (2 days) follows both B and C.
question: Using a backward pass, what is the late start (LS) of activity B?
option_A: Day 3
option_B: Day 5
option_C: Day 7
option_D: Day 9
explanation_en: The project ends on day 11. LS(D) = 9, so LF(B) = 9 and LS(B) = 9 − 4 = 5.
explanation_vi: Dự án kết thúc ngày 11. LS(D) = 9, nên LF(B) = 9 và LS(B) = 9 − 4 = 5.
in_short_vi: LF(B) = LS(D) = 9, nên LS(B) = 9 − 4 = 5.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

context: Network (the project starts at day 0): A (2 days) starts the project. B (3 days) follows A, and C (4 days) follows B. D (2 days) follows A, and E (1 day) follows D. F (3 days) follows both C and E.
question: What are the total float and the free float of activity D?
option_A: Total float 0 days; free float 0 days
option_B: Total float 4 days; free float 4 days
option_C: Total float 0 days; free float 4 days
option_D: Total float 4 days; free float 0 days
explanation_en: The critical path A-B-C-F = 12 days; path A-D-E-F = 8 days, so D's total float = 4. EF(D) = 4 and ES(E) = 4, so D's free float = 0.
explanation_vi: Đường găng A-B-C-F = 12 ngày; đường A-D-E-F = 8 ngày, nên total float của D = 4. EF(D) = 4 và ES(E) = 4, nên free float của D = 0.
in_short_en: D can slip 4 days without delaying the project (total float) but 0 days without delaying E (free float).
in_short_vi: D có thể trễ 4 ngày mà không làm trễ dự án (total float) nhưng 0 ngày nếu không muốn làm trễ E (free float).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: An activity has estimates of Optimistic = 6 days, Most likely = 9 days, and Pessimistic = 18 days. Using beta (PERT) estimating, what are the expected duration and standard deviation?
option_A: 10 days; standard deviation 12 days
option_B: 10 days; standard deviation 2 days
option_C: 9 days; standard deviation 2 days
option_D: 11 days; standard deviation 2 days
explanation_en: Beta: (6 + 4×9 + 18)/6 = 10. Standard deviation = (P − O)/6 = 12/6 = 2.
explanation_vi: Beta: (6 + 4×9 + 18)/6 = 10. Độ lệch chuẩn (standard deviation) = (P − O)/6 = 12/6 = 2.
in_short_en: Beta mean = (O + 4M + P)/6 = 10; standard deviation = (P − O)/6 = 2.
in_short_vi: Trung bình beta = (O + 4M + P)/6 = 10; độ lệch chuẩn = (P − O)/6 = 2.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project has a BAC of $100,000, an EV of $40,000, and an AC of $50,000. What to-complete performance index (TCPI) is needed to finish within the original BAC?
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A project has a BAC of $250,000, and the current EAC is $280,000. What is the variance at completion (VAC), and what does it mean?
option_A: −$30,000; the project is expected to finish over budget
option_B: +$30,000; the project is expected to finish over budget
option_C: +$30,000; the project is expected to finish under budget
option_D: −$30,000; the project is expected to finish under budget
explanation_en: VAC = BAC − EAC = $250,000 − $280,000 = −$30,000. A negative VAC means the project is expected to finish over budget.
explanation_vi: VAC = BAC − EAC = 250.000 − 280.000 = −30.000. VAC âm nghĩa là dự kiến vượt ngân sách.
in_short_en: VAC = BAC − EAC = −$30,000, so the project is expected to finish over budget.
in_short_vi: VAC = BAC − EAC = −30.000 USD, nên dự án dự kiến vượt ngân sách.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A card was added to the Kanban board on 3 March, pulled into "In progress" on 7 March, and finished on 11 March. What are its lead time and cycle time?
option_A: Lead time 4 days; cycle time 4 days
option_B: Lead time 8 days; cycle time 8 days
option_C: Lead time 4 days; cycle time 8 days
option_D: Lead time 8 days; cycle time 4 days
explanation_en: Lead time runs from when the request enters the board to done: 8 days. Cycle time runs from the start of work to done: 4 days.
explanation_vi: Lead time tính từ khi yêu cầu vào bảng đến khi xong: 8 ngày. Cycle time tính từ khi bắt đầu làm đến khi xong: 4 ngày.
in_short_en: Lead time runs from request to done (8 days); cycle time runs from start of work to done (4 days).
in_short_vi: Lead time tính từ lúc có yêu cầu đến khi xong (8 ngày); cycle time tính từ lúc bắt đầu làm đến khi xong (4 ngày).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A Kanban team finished 36 work items in the last 4 weeks. About 45 similar items remain. If throughput stays the same, about how long will the remaining work take?
option_A: About 1.25 weeks
option_B: About 4 weeks
option_C: About 5 weeks
option_D: About 9 weeks
explanation_en: Throughput = 36/4 = 9 items per week. 45/9 = 5 weeks.
explanation_vi: Throughput = 36/4 = 9 item mỗi tuần. 45/9 = 5 tuần.
in_short_en: Throughput is 9 items per week, so 45 items take about 5 weeks.
in_short_vi: Throughput là 9 hạng mục mỗi tuần, nên 45 hạng mục mất khoảng 5 tuần.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Option A costs $120,000 and returns $40,000 a year. Option B costs $90,000 and returns $25,000 a year. Using payback period only, which option should be chosen?
option_A: Option A, which pays back in 3 years
option_B: Option B, because its initial cost is lower
option_C: Option A, which pays back in 2.25 years
option_D: Option B, which pays back in 3.6 years
explanation_en: A: $120,000/$40,000 = 3 years. B: $90,000/$25,000 = 3.6 years. A has the shorter payback.
in_short_en: A pays back in 3 years versus 3.6 years for B, so choose A.
in_short_vi: A hoàn vốn trong 3 năm so với 3,6 năm của B, nên chọn A.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A team needs a tool for 24 months. Buying a license costs $500 a month. Building it costs $9,000 up front plus $200 a month for maintenance. Which option is cheaper, and by how much?
option_A: Buy, by $1,800
option_B: Buy, by $3,000
option_C: Build, by $4,800
option_D: Build, by $1,800
in_short_en: Buy = $12,000, build = $13,800, so buying saves $1,800.
in_short_vi: Mua tốn 12.000 USD, tự xây tốn 13.800 USD, nên mua tiết kiệm 1.800 USD.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: An e-commerce startup wants to learn whether customers will pay for same-day delivery, with the least effort, before building a full logistics system. What should the team release first?
option_A: A minimum viable product (MVP)
option_B: A minimum marketable feature (MMF)
option_C: A release candidate
option_D: A complete product increment
explanation_en: An MVP is the smallest version for testing an assumption with real customers, using the least effort.
explanation_vi: MVP là phiên bản nhỏ nhất để kiểm chứng một giả định với khách hàng thật, tốn ít công sức nhất.
in_short_en: Build an MVP to test a key assumption with the least effort.
in_short_vi: Làm MVP để kiểm chứng một giả định quan trọng với ít công sức nhất.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement BEST describes a timebox?
option_A: A buffer added at the end of the schedule to absorb identified risks
option_B: A period that is extended until all of the planned work is done
option_C: The time a work item waits between two steps in the workflow
option_D: A fixed period whose length does not change, even if work is unfinished
explanation_en: A timebox is a fixed period of time; when time is up you stop, and unfinished work goes back to the backlog.
explanation_vi: Timebox là khoảng thời gian cố định; hết giờ thì dừng, phần chưa xong quay lại backlog.
in_short_en: A timebox is a fixed period that does not stretch to fit the work.
in_short_vi: Timebox là khoảng thời gian cố định, không kéo dài để vừa với khối lượng việc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Sprint planning keeps stalling because stories arrive without acceptance criteria and with unresolved dependencies. What should the team agree on to prevent this?
option_A: A team working agreement
option_B: A definition of done
option_C: A product release plan
option_D: A definition of ready
explanation_en: A Definition of Ready (DoR) is the set of conditions a story must meet before it enters a sprint.
explanation_vi: Definition of Ready (DoR) là các điều kiện một story phải đạt trước khi được đưa vào sprint.
in_short_en: A definition of ready sets the conditions a story must meet before it enters a sprint.
in_short_vi: Definition of Ready đặt các điều kiện story phải đạt trước khi vào sprint.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which statement fits a DEEP product backlog?
option_A: Items near the top are more detailed than items lower down
option_B: Items are ordered by the date they were added to the backlog
option_C: Items are estimated once and are not re-estimated later
option_D: All items are detailed to the same level before work starts
explanation_en: DEEP: Detailed appropriately, Emergent, Estimated, Prioritized. Items near the top are more detailed than those lower down.
explanation_vi: DEEP: Detailed appropriately, Emergent, Estimated, Prioritized. Item gần đầu chi tiết hơn item phía dưới.
in_short_en: In a DEEP backlog, near-term items are more detailed than later ones.
in_short_vi: Trong backlog DEEP, hạng mục gần đầu chi tiết hơn hạng mục về sau.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Finished features sit in a queue for three weeks until a monthly release approval meeting. In Lean terms, which type of waste is this?
option_A: Motion
option_B: Waiting
option_C: Extra processing
option_D: Overproduction
explanation_en: Features that are finished but have to wait for approval are the waste of waiting (delays).
explanation_vi: Tính năng đã xong nhưng phải đợi duyệt là lãng phí chờ đợi (waiting, hay delays).
in_short_en: Finished work waiting in a queue is the waste of waiting.
in_short_vi: Việc đã xong nằm chờ trong hàng đợi là lãng phí chờ đợi.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: The "Test" column on a Kanban board has a WIP limit of 3 and already holds 3 cards. A developer has just finished coding a card. What should the developer do NEXT?
option_A: Raise the WIP limit for Test to 4 for this week
option_B: Help clear an item from Test before starting new work
option_C: Move the card into Test anyway so it is not forgotten
option_D: Start a new development item from the backlog
explanation_en: When a column reaches its WIP limit, help clear the bottleneck instead of pushing in more work.
explanation_vi: Khi cột đạt WIP limit, nên giúp giải phóng điểm nghẽn thay vì đẩy thêm việc vào.
in_short_en: When a column hits its WIP limit, help clear the bottleneck instead of starting more work.
in_short_vi: Khi cột chạm WIP limit, giúp gỡ điểm nghẽn thay vì bắt đầu thêm việc.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst documents how a customer returns an item, including the main success path and alternative paths such as an expired refund window. Which artifact is she creating?
option_A: A user story
option_B: A use case
option_C: A data dictionary
option_D: A context diagram
explanation_en: A use case describes the interaction between an actor and the system, including the main success scenario and alternative and exception flows.
explanation_vi: Use case mô tả tương tác giữa actor và hệ thống, gồm luồng chính (main success scenario) và luồng thay thế, ngoại lệ.
in_short_en: A use case describes the main and alternative flows between an actor and the system.
in_short_vi: Use case mô tả luồng chính và luồng thay thế giữa actor và hệ thống.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A business analyst compares the current checkout process with the desired future state to find what must change. Which technique is this?
option_A: Gap analysis
option_B: Benchmarking
option_C: Document analysis
option_D: Stakeholder analysis
explanation_en: Gap analysis compares the current state with the desired future state to find the gap.
explanation_vi: Gap analysis so sánh trạng thái hiện tại (current state) với trạng thái mong muốn (future state) để tìm khoảng cách.
in_short_en: Gap analysis compares the current state with the desired future state.
in_short_vi: Gap analysis so sánh trạng thái hiện tại với trạng thái tương lai mong muốn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Stakeholders disagree about which department handles each step of order fulfillment and where handoffs happen. Which model would BEST make this clear?
option_A: A use case diagram
option_B: A context diagram
option_C: A swimlane process flow
option_D: An entity relationship diagram
explanation_en: A swimlane process flow places each step in the lane of the department doing it, showing clearly who does what and where handoffs happen.
explanation_vi: Swimlane process flow chia các bước theo làn của từng bộ phận, cho thấy rõ ai làm gì và chỗ chuyển giao.
in_short_en: A swimlane process flow shows who does each step and where handoffs occur.
in_short_vi: Swimlane process flow cho thấy ai làm từng bước và chuyển giao xảy ra ở đâu.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: While planning, a project manager reviews four inputs. Which one is an organizational process asset (OPA) rather than an enterprise environmental factor (EEF)?
option_A: A culture that discourages open disagreement
option_B: New government regulations on data privacy
option_C: The company's archived risk register templates
option_D: A shortage of skilled testers in the local market
explanation_en: OPAs are the organization's processes, policies, templates, and knowledge repositories, such as risk register templates or lessons learned.
explanation_vi: OPA là quy trình, chính sách, template và kho kiến thức của tổ chức, như template risk register hay lessons learned.
in_short_en: Templates and lessons learned are OPAs; culture, regulations, and markets are EEFs.
in_short_vi: Template và lessons learned là OPA; văn hóa, quy định và thị trường là EEF.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Phase 1 of a project is broken down into work packages, while phases 2 and 3 are kept as high-level planning packages until more is known. Which technique is being used?
option_A: Rolling wave planning
option_B: Schedule fast tracking
option_C: Resource leveling
option_D: Analogous estimating
explanation_en: Rolling wave planning: plan near-term work in detail, keep later work at a high level, and detail it later.
explanation_vi: Rolling wave planning: lập kế hoạch chi tiết cho công việc gần, công việc xa giữ ở mức cao và chi tiết dần sau.
in_short_en: Detailing near-term work and keeping later work high-level is rolling wave planning.
in_short_vi: Lên chi tiết cho việc gần và giữ việc xa ở mức tổng quát là rolling wave planning.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: What does the 100% rule mean for a WBS?
option_A: Each level must be fully estimated before it is decomposed
option_B: Every team member must approve the WBS before it is baselined
option_C: The WBS covers all project work and nothing outside the scope
option_D: Each work package must be complete before the next one starts
explanation_en: The 100% rule: the WBS includes all of the project's work, nothing more and nothing less; each level's children add up to 100% of the parent.
explanation_vi: Quy tắc 100%: WBS bao gồm toàn bộ công việc của dự án, không thừa không thiếu; mỗi cấp con cộng lại bằng 100% cấp cha.
in_short_en: The 100% rule means the WBS includes all of the project work and nothing more.
in_short_vi: Quy tắc 100% nghĩa là WBS bao gồm toàn bộ công việc của dự án và không có gì thêm.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A team member is well paid and has good working conditions but says her work no longer motivates her. According to Herzberg, what is MOST likely to increase her motivation?
option_A: Better office equipment and working space
option_B: Another increase in her salary and bonus
option_C: Clearer company policies and HR procedures
option_D: More responsibility and recognition
explanation_en: Herzberg: hygiene factors such as pay and working conditions only prevent dissatisfaction; motivators such as responsibility and recognition create motivation.
explanation_vi: Herzberg: yếu tố duy trì (hygiene factors) như lương, điều kiện làm việc chỉ ngăn bất mãn; yếu tố động viên (motivators) như trách nhiệm, ghi nhận mới tạo động lực.
in_short_en: Per Herzberg, responsibility and recognition motivate; pay and conditions only prevent dissatisfaction.
in_short_vi: Theo Herzberg, trách nhiệm và sự ghi nhận tạo động lực; lương và điều kiện làm việc chỉ ngăn bất mãn.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A manager believes team members dislike work and will only perform under close supervision. Which theory describes this view?
option_A: McGregor's Theory Y
option_B: Herzberg's hygiene theory
option_C: McGregor's Theory X
option_D: Vroom's expectancy theory
explanation_en: McGregor's Theory X assumes workers dislike work and need close supervision.
explanation_vi: Theory X của McGregor cho rằng người lao động không thích làm việc và cần bị giám sát chặt.
in_short_en: Assuming people dislike work and need close supervision is McGregor's Theory X.
in_short_vi: Cho rằng người lao động không thích làm việc và cần giám sát chặt là Theory X của McGregor.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A virtual team spread across three time zones keeps misunderstanding decisions made in chat. What should the project manager do FIRST?
option_A: Replace chat with written weekly reports only
option_B: Ask all members to work in the project manager's time zone
option_C: Move every discussion to email so there is a record
option_D: Agree on overlap hours and on which channel to use for what
explanation_en: A virtual team should agree on communication norms: shared working hours, which channel to use for what, and where decisions are made.
explanation_vi: Với đội ảo (virtual team), nên thống nhất quy tắc giao tiếp: giờ làm việc chung, kênh nào dùng cho việc gì, ra quyết định ở đâu.
in_short_en: Set communication norms such as overlap hours and channel rules for virtual teams.
in_short_vi: Đội làm việc từ xa cần quy tắc giao tiếp như khung giờ chung và quy định dùng kênh.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: Which of these spending items is a cost of nonconformance?
option_A: Peer reviews of code before each production release
option_B: Training developers in secure coding practices
option_C: Running automated regression tests every night
option_D: Rework on a feature that failed acceptance testing
explanation_en: The cost of nonconformance is the cost caused by defects: rework (internal failure), warranty, and complaints (external failure).
explanation_vi: Chi phí không phù hợp (cost of nonconformance) là chi phí do lỗi: làm lại (internal failure), bảo hành, khiếu nại (external failure).
in_short_en: Rework caused by defects is a failure cost, part of the cost of nonconformance.
in_short_vi: Làm lại do lỗi là chi phí thất bại, thuộc chi phí không phù hợp (cost of nonconformance).
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: On a control chart, seven consecutive points fall above the mean, but all are within the control limits. What does this indicate?
option_A: The process is in control because all points are within limits
option_B: The customer's specification limits have been exceeded
option_C: The upper control limit should be raised to fit the data
option_D: The process may be out of control and should be investigated
explanation_en: The rule of seven: seven consecutive points on the same side of the mean suggest the process may be out of control.
explanation_vi: Quy tắc bảy điểm (rule of seven): bảy điểm liên tiếp cùng một phía đường trung bình cho thấy quá trình có thể mất kiểm soát.
in_short_en: Seven consecutive points on one side of the mean suggest the process may be out of control.
in_short_vi: Bảy điểm liên tiếp cùng một phía đường trung bình cho thấy quá trình có thể mất kiểm soát.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room

question: A team inspects 50 out of 5,000 manufactured units instead of all of them. What is the MOST likely reason?
option_A: Sampling gives more accurate results than testing every unit
option_B: The quality management plan forbids testing every unit
option_C: Testing every unit would cost too much or destroy the units
option_D: Sampling removes the need for acceptance criteria
explanation_en: Statistical sampling is used when inspecting everything is too costly, too slow, or destroys the product.
explanation_vi: Lấy mẫu thống kê (statistical sampling) dùng khi kiểm tra toàn bộ quá tốn kém, mất thời gian hoặc phá hủy sản phẩm.
in_short_en: Sampling is used when inspecting every unit is too costly or destructive.
in_short_vi: Lấy mẫu được dùng khi kiểm tra từng đơn vị quá tốn kém hoặc phá hủy sản phẩm.
source: Original question written for CAPM Practice Room
